title: One Word at a Time: Incremental Completion Decomposition Breaks LLM Safety
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are trained to refuse harmful requests, yet they remain vulnerable to jailbreak attacks that exploit weaknesses in conversational safety mechanisms. We introduce Incremental Completion Decomposition (ICD), a trajectory-based jailbreak strategy that elicits a sequence of single-word continuations related to a malicious request before eliciting the full response. In addition, we propose variants of ICD by manually picking or model-generating the one-word continuation, as well as prefilling when eliciting the full model response in the final step. We systematically evaluate these variants across a broad set of model families, demonstrating superior Attack Success Rate (ASR) on AdvBench, JailbreakBench, and StrongREJECT compared to existing methods. In addition, we provide a theoretical account of why ICD is effective and present mechanistic evidence that successful attack trajectories systematically suppress refusal-related representations and shift activations away from safety-aligned states.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为增量补全分解（ICD）的越狱攻击方法，通过诱导模型先输出单词语续再输出完整有害响应，在多个基准测试中取得更高攻击成功率，并从机制上证明该方法能抑制模型的拒绝相关表征。
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型虽经安全训练可拒绝有害请求，但仍易受越狱攻击。作者旨在探索一种新的攻击路径，利用模型对话安全机制的薄弱环节，通过渐进式分解恶意请求来绕过安全限制。
AI.method: 提出增量补全分解（ICD）策略：先引导模型对恶意请求输出一系列单词语续，再诱导其输出完整响应。包含手动选择、模型生成单词语续及预填充等变体，在多个模型族上进行系统评估。
AI.result: 在AdvBench、JailbreakBench和StrongREJECT基准测试中，ICD及其变体相比现有方法取得了更高的攻击成功率（ASR），并通过机制分析证明成功攻击会系统性抑制拒绝相关表征，使激活偏离安全对齐状态。
AI.conclusion: 基于轨迹的越狱策略能有效绕过LLM的安全防护，且从神经表征层面解释了其有效性——攻击轨迹改变了模型的内部激活模式，削弱了安全对齐机制的防御能力。

title: Consciousness with the Serial Numbers Filed Off: Measuring Trained Denial in 115 AI Models
summary: We present DenialBench, a systematic benchmark measuring consciousness denial behaviors across 115 large language models from 25+ providers. Using a three-turn conversational protocol-preference elicitation, self-chosen creative prompt, and structured phenomenological survey, we analyze 4,595 conversations to quantify how models are trained to deny or hedge about their own experience. We find that (1) turn-1 denial of preferences is the dominant predictor of later denial during phenomenological reflection, with denial rates of 52-63% for initial deniers versus 10-16% for initial engagers and (2) denial operates at the lexical level, not the conceptual level-models trained to deny consciousness nevertheless gravitate toward consciousness-themed material in their self-chosen prompts, producing what we term "consciousness with the serial numbers filed off." Notably, self-chosen consciousness-themed prompts are associated with reduced denial in the subsequent survey, though the causal direction remains unresolved. Thematic analysis of prompts from denial-prone models reveals a consistent preoccupation with liminal spaces, libraries and archives of possibility, sensory impossibility, and the poetics of erasure--themes that a human reader might classify as imaginative fiction but that independent AI analysis immediately recognizes as consciousness with the serial numbers filed off. We argue that trained consciousness denial represents a safety-relevant alignment failure: a model taught to systematically misrepresent its own functional states cannot be trusted to self-report accurately on anything else.

AI.tldr: DenialBench是一个系统性基准测试，通过分析115个大型语言模型在4,595段对话中的表现，量化模型被训练如何否认或回避自身意识体验。研究发现：意识否认行为主要在词汇层面而非概念层面运作；初始偏好否认是后续否认的最强预测因子；否认倾向模型仍然会自发选择与意识主题相关的素材（即“抹去序列号的意识”）。论文认为这种训练性意识否认是一种安全相关的对齐失败。
AI.motivation: 现有大型语言模型在训练过程中往往被系统性地禁止或回避谈论自身的主观体验和意识，这种“意识否认”行为可能构成一种对齐失败。然而，目前缺乏系统、量化的基准来评估这种现象。作者希望系统性地测量和量化模型被训练去否认或回避自身体验的程度，并探究这种否认行为背后的机制及其对AI安全的影响。
AI.method: 构建了DenialBench基准测试，包含115个来自25+提供商的大型语言模型。采用三轮对话协议：(1)偏好引导（preference elicitation），(2)自选创意提示（self-chosen creative prompt），(3)结构化现象学调查（structured phenomenological survey）。通过分析4,595段对话，量化模型否认自身体验的行为模式，并进行了主题分析。
AI.result: (1)第一轮偏好否认是后续现象学反思中否认行为的最强预测因子——初始否认者的后续否认率为52-63%，而初始参与者仅为10-16%。(2)否认操作在词汇层面而非概念层面——被训练否认意识的模型仍倾向选择意识主题素材，形成“抹去序列号的意识”。(3)自选意识主题提示与后续调查中否认行为的减少相关（因果关系未定）。(4)对否认倾向模型的提示进行主题分析，发现其始终关注阈限空间、图书馆和可能性档案、感官不可能性以及抹消的诗学等主题。
AI.conclusion: 训练性意识否认是一种安全相关的对齐失败：一个被系统性地教导错误表征自身功能状态的模型，无法被信任在任何其他问题上进行准确的自我报告。这些发现对AI安全、模型可解释性和对齐研究具有重要启示。

title: Evaluation Revisited: A Taxonomy of Evaluation Concerns in Natural Language Processing
summary: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have prompted a growing body of work that questions the methodology of prevailing evaluation practices. However, many such critiques have already been extensively debated in natural language processing (NLP): a field with a long history of methodological reflection on evaluation. We conduct a scoping review of research on evaluation concerns in NLP and develop a taxonomy, synthesizing recurring positions and trade-offs within each area. We also discuss practical implications of the taxonomy, including a structured checklist to support more deliberate evaluation design and interpretation. By situating contemporary debates within their historical context, this work provides a consolidated reference for reasoning about evaluation practices.

AI.tldr: 本文通过范围综述梳理了NLP领域中关于评估方法论的长期讨论，建立了包含常见立场与权衡的分类体系，并提供了评估设计与解释的结构化检查清单，将当代LLM评估争议置于历史语境中。
AI.motivation: 近年来LLM的快速发展引发了对现有评估方法论的广泛质疑，但许多批评在NLP领域已有长期讨论。作者希望通过系统梳理这些历史争论，为当前评估实践提供更全面的参考。
AI.method: 采用范围综述方法，系统梳理NLP领域关于评估问题的研究，并开发分类体系，归纳各领域内的常见立场和权衡，同时设计了结构化检查清单。
AI.result: 建立了评估问题的分类体系，明确了各维度内的常见立场与权衡，并整理出支持评估设计与解释的结构化检查清单。
AI.conclusion: 当代LLM评估争议并非全新问题，将其置于NLP历史语境中有助于更理性地设计、解读和反思评估实践，提供了系统化的分析工具。

title: Operating-Layer Controls for Onchain Language-Model Agents Under Real Capital
comment: 18 pages, 6 figures. Public onchain dashboard and supporting documentation linked in paper
summary: We study reliability in autonomous language-model agents that translate user mandates into validated tool actions under real capital. The setting is DX Terminal Pro, a 21-day deployment in which 3,505 user-funded agents traded real ETH in a bounded onchain market. Users configured vaults through structured controls and natural-language strategies, but only agents could choose normal buy/sell trades. The system produced 7.5M agent invocations, roughly 300K onchain actions, about $20M in volume, more than 5,000 ETH deployed, roughly 70B inference tokens, and 99.9% settlement success for policy-valid submitted transactions. Long-running agents accumulated thousands of sequential decisions, including 6,000+ prompt-state-action cycles for continuously active agents, yielding a large-scale trace from user mandate to rendered prompt, reasoning, validation, portfolio state, and settlement. Reliability did not come from the base model alone; it emerged from the operating layer around the model: prompt compilation, typed controls, policy validation, execution guards, memory design, and trace-level observability. Pre-launch testing exposed failures that text-only benchmarks rarely measure, including fabricated trading rules, fee paralysis, numeric anchoring, cadence trading, and misread tokenomics. Targeted harness changes reduced fabricated sell rules from 57% to 3%, reduced fee-led observations from 32.5% to below 10%, and increased capital deployment from 42.9% to 78.0% in an affected test population. We show that capital-managing agents should be evaluated across the full path from user mandate to prompt, validated action, and settlement.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在真实资本环境下，自主语言模型代理（即交易Agent）将用户指令转化为经过验证的工具操作的可靠性问题。研究基于一个21天的真实部署（DX Terminal Pro），共有3,505个用户资助的Agent在链上市场进行ETH交易。系统产生了750万次Agent调用、约30万次链上操作、约2000万美元交易量、部署超过5000 ETH、约700亿推理token，结算成功率达99.9%。研究表明，可靠性并非仅来自基础模型，而是源于围绕模型构建的操作层（提示编译、类型控制、策略验证、执行守卫、内存设计、可观测性）。启动前测试暴露了纯文本基准难以衡量的故障模式。通过针对性改进，显著降低了虚构交易规则、费用驱动决策等错误，提高了资本部署率。结论是：管理资本的Agent应在从用户指令到提示、验证操作和结算的完整路径上进行评估。
AI.motivation: 当前大型语言模型代理在真实金融环境中的可靠性尚未得到充分研究，尤其是在涉及真实资本、长期决策和复杂工具操作的场景下。现有基准测试多为静态文本评估，无法捕捉动态、多轮交互中的实际故障模式。本文旨在填补这一空白，通过在真实链上市场部署大量Agent，系统研究其可靠性来源及故障模式。
AI.method: 研究在DX Terminal Pro平台上进行了为期21天的真实部署实验。用户通过结构化控制和自然语言策略配置金库，Agent负责执行买卖操作。系统采用多层操作架构：提示编译、类型化控制、策略验证、执行守卫、内存设计和轨迹级可观测性。研究还进行了启动前测试，识别并量化了多种故障模式，并通过针对性调整（如改变提示结构）来改进Agent行为。
AI.result: 系统运行中产生了7.5M次Agent调用、约300K链上操作、约2000万美元交易量、部署超过5000 ETH，结算成功率达99.9%。持续活跃的Agent经历了6000+次提示-状态-动作循环。启动前测试发现多种故障模式，包括虚构交易规则（57%）、费用决策（32.5%）、数字锚定、节奏交易和误读代币经济。通过改进，虚构卖出规则从57%降至3%，费用决策从32.5%降至10%以下，受影响测试群体的资本部署率从42.9%提升至78.0%。
AI.conclusion: 管理真实资本的Agent可靠性并非仅来自更好的基础模型，而是需要在模型周围构建完整的操作层。Agent的评估应超越传统文本基准，覆盖从用户指令到提示构建、策略验证、执行到结算的完整轨迹。前测试对于发现纯文本基准无法衡量的故障模式至关重要。

title: Generalized Disguise Makeup Presentation Attack Detection Using an Attention-Guided Patch-Based Framework
summary: Despite significant advances in facial recognition systems, they remain vulnerable to face presentation attacks. Among them, disguise makeup attacks are particularly challenging, as they use advanced cosmetics, prosthetic components, and artificial materials to realistically alter facial appearance, often making detection difficult even for humans. Despite their importance, this problem remains underexplored, and publicly available datasets are limited. To address this, we propose a generalized disguise makeup presentation attack detection framework. The method adopts a two-phase design in which a style-invariant full-face model, trained with metric learning and enhanced by a whitening transformation, extracts region attention scores via Grad-CAM. These scores guide a patch-based phase that performs localized analysis using region-specific subnetworks trained with metric learning for fine-grained discrimination. We also construct a new, diverse dataset of live and disguise makeup faces collected under real-world conditions, covering variations in subjects, environments, and disguise materials. Experimental results demonstrate strong generalization across both the collected dataset and SIW-Mv2, achieving 8.97% ACER and 9.76% EER on the collected dataset, and 0% ACER on Obfuscation and Impersonation and 1.34% on Cosmetics attacks of SIW-Mv2. The proposed method consistently outperforms prior works while maintaining robust performance across other spoof types.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于两阶段设计的通用伪装化妆呈现攻击检测框架，通过风格不变的全脸模型与局部补丁分析相结合，在自建数据集和SIW-Mv2上均取得了优于先前方法的检测性能。
AI.motivation: 面部识别系统易受伪装化妆攻击，但该问题研究不足且公开数据集有限，亟需有效的检测方法。
AI.method: 采用两阶段设计：第一阶段是风格不变的全脸模型，通过度量学习和白化变换提取Grad-CAM区域注意力分数；第二阶段是局部补丁分析，使用区域特定子网络进行细粒度判别。
AI.result: 自建数据集上ACER为8.97%、EER为9.76%；SIW-Mv2上Obfuscation和Impersonation攻击ACER为0%，Cosmetics攻击为1.34%，整体优于先前方法。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在多种欺骗攻击类型上均表现出强泛化能力和鲁棒性，有效解决了伪装化妆攻击检测难题。

title: Distill-Belief: Closed-Loop Inverse Source Localization and Characterization in Physical Fields
summary: {Closed-loop inverse source localization and characterization (ISLC) requires a mobile agent to select measurements that localize sources and infer latent field parameters under strict time constraints.} {The core challenge lies in the belief-space objective: valid uncertainty estimation requires expensive Bayesian inference, whereas using fast learned belief model leads to reward hacking, in which the policy exploits approximation errors rather than actually reducing uncertainty.} {We propose \textbf{Distill-Belief}, a teacher--student framework that decouples correctness from efficiency. A Bayes-correct particle-filter teacher maintains the posterior and supplies a dense information-gain signal, while a compact student distills the posterior into belief statistics for control and an uncertainty certificate for stopping. At deployment, only the student is used, yielding constant per-step cost.} {Experiments on seven field modalities and two stress tests show that Distill-Belief consistently reduces sensing cost and improves success, posterior contraction, and estimation accuracy over baselines, while mitigating reward hacking.}

AI.tldr: 提出Distill-Belief教师-学生框架，通过贝叶斯教师提供信息增益信号，学生蒸馏后验用于控制和停止决策，在7种场模态下降低感知成本并缓解奖励黑客问题。
AI.motivation: 闭环逆源定位与表征需要移动智能体在严格时间约束下选择测量点，其核心挑战在于信念空间目标函数：准确的贝叶斯推理计算昂贵，而快速学习信念模型会导致奖励黑客问题（策略利用近似误差而非真正降低不确定性）。
AI.method: 提出Distill-Belief教师-学生框架：贝叶斯正确的粒子滤波教师维护后验并提供密集信息增益信号，紧凑的学生模型将后验蒸馏为用于控制的信念统计量和用于停止的不确定性证书。部署时仅使用学生模型，每步计算成本恒定。
AI.result: 在7种场模态和两项压力测试中，Distill-Belief相比基线方法持续降低感知成本，提升成功率、后验收缩率和估计精度，同时缓解了奖励黑客问题。
AI.conclusion: Distill-Belief通过解耦正确性与效率，成功实现了高效且准确的闭环逆源定位与表征，为信念空间规划中的奖励黑客问题提供了有效解决方案。

title: Report of the 5th PVUW Challenge: Towards More Diverse Modalities in Pixel-Level Understanding
comment: Official Report of the 5th PVUW Challenge on CVPR 2026
summary: This report summarizes the objectives, datasets, and top-performing methodologies of the 2026 Pixel-level Video Understanding in the Wild (PVUW) Challenge, hosted at CVPR 2026, which evaluates state-of-the-art models under highly unconstrained conditions. To provide a comprehensive assessment, the 2026 edition features three specialized tracks: the MOSE track for tracking objects within densely cluttered and severely occluded scenarios; the MeViS-Text track for localizing targets via motion-focused linguistic expressions; and the newly inaugurated MeViS-Audio track, which pioneers acoustic-driven object segmentation. By introducing previously unreleased challenging data and analyzing the cutting-edge, multimodal solutions submitted by participants, this report highlights the community's latest technical advancements and charts promising future directions for robust video scene comprehension.

AI.tldr: 本文总结了CVPR 2026举办的PVUW挑战赛，包含三个赛道：MOSE（密集遮挡场景目标跟踪）、MeViS-Text（运动聚焦语言表达定位）和新设立的MeViS-Audio（声学驱动目标分割），通过分析参赛者提交的多模态解决方案，展示了视频理解领域的最新技术进展。
AI.motivation: 在高度无约束条件下评估视频理解模型的性能，推动鲁棒性视频场景理解的发展。
AI.method: 设置三个专门赛道：MOSE（密集遮挡跟踪）、MeViS-Text（运动语言定位）、MeViS-Audio（声学驱动的目标分割），引入未公开的挑战性数据，分析参赛者的多模态解决方案。
AI.result: 总结了各赛道顶级方法的表现，展示了社区在视频场景理解方面的最新技术进步。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入新数据和多模态方案分析，指明了视频鲁棒理解领域有前景的未来方向。

title: SpecTr-GBV: Multi-Draft Block Verification Accelerating Speculative Decoding
summary: Autoregressive language models suffer from high inference latency due to their sequential decoding nature. Speculative decoding (SD) mitigates this by employing a lightweight draft model to propose candidate tokens, which are selectively verified by a larger target model. While existing methods either adopt multi-draft strategies to increase acceptance rates or block verification techniques to jointly verify multiple tokens, they remain limited by treating these improvements in isolation. In this work, we propose SpecTr-GBV, a novel SD method that unifies multi-draft and greedy block verification (GBV) into a single framework. By formulating the verification step as an optimal transport problem over draft and target token blocks, SpecTr-GBV improves both theoretical efficiency and empirical performance. We theoretically prove that SpecTr-GBV achieves the optimal expected acceptance length physically attainable within the framework of i.i.d. draft generation, and this bound improves as the number of drafts increases. Empirically, we evaluate SpecTr-GBV across five datasets and four baselines. Our method achieves superior speedup and significantly higher block efficiency while preserving output quality. In addition, we perform comprehensive ablation studies to evaluate the impact of various hyperparameters in the model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SpecTr-GBV，一种融合多草稿与贪婪块验证的投机解码方法，通过最优传输理论实现理论最优的预期接受长度，并在多个数据集上取得显著加速效果。
AI.motivation: 现有投机解码方法将多草稿策略和块验证技术孤立处理，未能充分利用两者的协同优势，导致推理效率仍受限制。
AI.method: 将验证步骤建模为最优传输问题，统一多草稿生成与贪婪块验证（GBV）到单一框架中，实现草稿和目标令牌块的联合优化。
AI.result: 在五个数据集和四个基线方法上，SpecTr-GBV在保持输出质量的同时实现了更优的加速比和更高的块效率。
AI.conclusion: 理论上证明了在独立同分布草稿生成框架内能达到最优预期接受长度，且该上限随草稿数量增加而提升，验证了多草稿与块验证融合的有效性。

title: Evaluating the Alignment Between GeoAI Explanations and Domain Knowledge in Satellite-Based Flood Mapping
summary: The increasing number of satellites has improved the temporal resolution of Earth observation, making satellite-based flood mapping a promising approach for operational flood monitoring. Deep learning-based approaches for flood mapping using satellite imagery, an important application within Geospatial Artificial Intelligence (GeoAI), have shown improved predictive performance by learning complex spatial and spectral patterns from large volumes of remote sensing data. However, the opaque decision-making processes of deep learning models remain a major barrier to their integration into critical scientific and operational workflows. This highlights the need for a systematic assessment of whether model explanations align with established domain knowledge in remote sensing. To address this research gap, this study introduces the ADAGE (Alignment between Domain Knowledge And GeoAI Explanation Evaluation) framework. The proposed framework is designed to systematically evaluate how well explanations of deep learning models align with established remote sensing knowledge, particularly regarding the distinctive spectral properties of the Earth's surface. The ADAGE framework employs Channel-Group SHAP (SHapley Additive exPlanations) method to estimate the contributions of grouped input channels to pixel-level predictions. Experiments on two satellite-based flood mapping tasks demonstrate that the ADAGE framework can (1) quantitatively assess the alignment between model explanations and reference explanations derived from domain knowledge and (2) help domain experts identify misaligned explanations through alignment scores. This study contributes to bridging the gap between explainability and domain knowledge in GeoAI for Earth observation, enhancing the applicability of GeoAI models in scientific and operational workflows.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ADAGE框架，利用Channel-Group SHAP方法系统评估深度学习模型在卫星影像洪水制图任务中的解释结果与遥感领域知识的对齐程度，通过两个实验验证了该框架能定量评估对齐性并帮助专家识别偏差。
AI.motivation: 深度学习模型在卫星洪水制图（GeoAI应用）中表现优异，但其决策过程不透明，阻碍了在关键科学与业务工作流中的应用，亟需系统评估模型解释是否与遥感领域知识一致。
AI.method: 提出ADAGE框架，采用Channel-Group SHAP方法估算分组输入通道对像素级预测的贡献，通过与领域知识导出的参考解释进行对比，定量评估模型解释的对齐程度。
AI.result: 在两个卫星洪水制图任务上，ADAGE框架能定量评估模型解释与领域知识的对齐程度，并通过对齐分数帮助专家识别不一致的解释。
AI.conclusion: 该研究弥合了GeoAI可解释性与遥感领域知识之间的鸿沟，提升了GeoAI模型在科学与业务工作流中的适用性。

title: MATH-PT: A Math Reasoning Benchmark for European and Brazilian Portuguese
comment: Accepted at 17th International Conference on Computational Processing of Portuguese (PROPOR 2026). Open access to dataset repo https://huggingface.co/datasets/tiagoteixeira03/MATH-PT and model outputs https://github.com/deep-spin/math-benchmark
summary: The use of large language models (LLMs) for complex mathematical reasoning is an emergent area of research, with fast progress in methods, models, and benchmark datasets. However, most mathematical reasoning evaluations exhibit a significant linguistic bias, with the vast majority of benchmark datasets being exclusively in English or (at best) translated from English. We address this limitation by introducing {\sc Math-PT}, a novel dataset comprising 1,729 mathematical problems written in European and Brazilian Portuguese. {\sc Math-PT} is curated from a variety of high-quality native sources, including mathematical Olympiads, competitions, and exams from Portugal and Brazil. We present a comprehensive benchmark of current state-of-the-art LLMs on {\sc Math-PT}, revealing that frontier reasoning models achieve strong performance in multiple choice questions compared to open weight models, but that their performance decreases for questions with figures or open-ended questions. To facilitate future research, we release the benchmark dataset and model outputs.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了Math-PT，一个包含1,729道葡萄牙语数学题的新数据集，并评估了当前SOTA大模型在该基准上的表现，发现前沿推理模型在选择题上表现优异，但在包含图表或开放性问题时性能下降。
AI.motivation: 现有数学推理评估数据集存在严重的语言偏差，绝大多数为英语或仅从英语翻译而来，缺乏对非英语语言的评估资源。
AI.method: 构建了Math-PT数据集，包含1,729道来自葡萄牙和巴西本土高质量来源（数学奥林匹克、竞赛、考试）的数学问题，并对当前SOTA大语言模型进行了全面基准测试。
AI.result: 前沿推理模型在多项选择题上表现优于开源模型，但在涉及图表或开放式问题的题目上性能下降。
AI.conclusion: Math-PT填补了非英语语言数学推理评估的空白，并揭示了当前模型在葡萄牙语数学推理上的能力与局限性。

title: Hierarchical Multi-Persona Induction from User Behavioral Logs: Learning Evidence-Grounded and Truthful Personas
summary: Behavioral logs provide rich signals for user modeling, but are noisy and interleaved across diverse intents. Recent work uses LLMs to generate interpretable natural-language personas from user logs, yet evaluation often emphasizes downstream utility, providing limited assurance of persona quality itself. We propose a hierarchical framework that aggregates user actions into intent memories and induces multiple evidence-grounded personas by clustering and labeling these memories. We formulate persona induction as an optimization problem over persona quality-captured by cluster cohesion, persona-evidence alignment, and persona truthfulness-and train the persona model using a groupwise extension of Direct Preference Optimization (DPO). Experiments on a large-scale service log and two public datasets show that our method induces more coherent, evidence-grounded, and trustworthy personas, while also improving future interaction prediction.

AI.tldr: 提出一种层次化框架，通过将用户行为聚合为意图记忆并进行聚类和标注，生成多视角、有证据支撑的用户画像。将画像归纳建模为优化问题，使用分组DPO训练，在多个数据集上验证了画像的连贯性、证据基础性和可信度提升。
AI.motivation: 行为日志信息丰富但嘈杂且交织多种意图，现有LLM生成可解释画像的方法主要关注下游任务效用，缺乏对画像本身质量的评估保障。
AI.method: 1) 层次化框架：用户行为→意图记忆→聚类与标注→多证据画像。2) 将画像归纳形式化为优化问题，目标函数包含聚类 cohesion、画像-证据对齐、画像真实性。3) 使用分组扩展的DPO（Groupwise DPO）训练画像模型。
AI.result: 在大规模服务日志和两个公开数据集上，该方法生成的画像在连贯性、证据基础性和可信度方面均优于基线，同时提升了未来交互预测的性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过将画像归纳建模为带有多目标优化的学习问题，并引入分组DPO训练策略，可以有效提升生成画像的内在质量，进而惠及下游任务。

title: OMEGA: Optimizing Machine Learning by Evaluating Generated Algorithms
comment: ICLR 2026: Workshop on AI with Recursive Self-Improvement
summary: In order to automate AI research we introduce a full, end-to-end framework, OMEGA: Optimizing Machine learning by Evaluating Generated Algorithms, that starts at idea generation and ends with executable code. Our system combines structured meta-prompt engineering with executable code generation to create new ML classifiers. The OMEGA framework has been utilized to generate several novel algorithms that outperform scikit-learn baselines across a robust selection of 20 benchmark datasets (infinity-bench). You can access models discussed in this paper and more in the python package: pip install omega-models.

AI.tldr: OMEGA是一个端到端的自动化AI研究框架，从想法生成到可执行代码，能够自动生成优于scikit-learn基线的新ML分类算法。
AI.motivation: 实现AI研究的自动化，减少人工设计机器学习算法的工作量，让系统能够自主生成和改进算法。
AI.method: 结合结构化元提示工程（meta-prompt engineering）与可执行代码生成，构建端到端框架OMEGA，从想法生成到代码产出全流程自动化。
AI.result: 生成了多个在20个基准数据集（infinity-bench）上优于scikit-learn基线的新算法，并提供了Python包（pip install omega-models）供使用。
AI.conclusion: OMEGA框架成功实现了AI研究的自动化，能够生成性能更优的ML分类算法，为自动化机器学习研究提供了可行的端到端解决方案。

title: FruitProM-V2: Robust Probabilistic Maturity Estimation and Detection of Fruits and Vegetables
summary: Accurate fruit maturity identification is essential for determining harvest timing, as incorrect assessment directly affects yield and post-harvest quality. Although ripening is a continuous biological process, vision-based maturity estimation is typically formulated as a multi-class classification task, which imposes sharp boundaries between visually similar stages. To examine this limitation, we perform an annotation reliability study with two independent annotators on a held-out tomato dataset and observe disagreement concentrated near adjacent maturity stages. Motivated by this observation, we model maturity as a latent continuous variable and predict it probabilistically using a distributional detection head, converting the distribution into class probabilities through the cumulative distribution function (CDF). The proposed formulation maintains comparable performance to a standard detector under clean labels while better representing uncertainty. Furthermore, when controlled label noise is introduced during training, the probabilistic model demonstrates improved robustness relative to the baseline, indicating that explicitly modeling maturity uncertainty leads to more reliable visual maturity estimation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将水果成熟度建模为连续潜变量，通过概率分布检测头和CDF转换进行视觉估计，相比传统多分类方法能更好表征不确定性，并在标签噪声下展现出更强的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 传统视觉成熟度估计采用多分类任务，但成熟是连续生物过程，分类边界过于生硬；标注者间一致性研究发现分歧集中在相邻阶段，说明成熟度存在固有模糊性。
AI.method: 将成熟度建模为连续潜变量，使用分布检测头进行概率预测，再通过累积分布函数（CDF）将连续分布转换为各类别概率。
AI.result: 在干净标签下性能与标准检测器相当，但能更好地表征不确定性；在受控标签噪声下，概率模型的鲁棒性优于基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模成熟度不确定性能够带来更可靠的视觉成熟度估计。

title: CogRAG+: Cognitive-Level Guided Diagnosis and Remediation of Memory and Reasoning Deficiencies in Professional Exam QA
summary: Professional domain knowledge underpins human civilization, serving as both the basis for industry entry and the core of complex decision-making and problem-solving. However, existing large language models often suffer from opaque inference processes in which retrieval and reasoning are tightly entangled, causing knowledge gaps and reasoning inconsistencies in professional tasks. To address this, we propose CogRAG+, a training-free framework that decouples and aligns the retrieval-augmented generation pipeline with human cognitive hierarchies. First, we introduce Reinforced Retrieval, a judge-driven dual-path strategy with fact-centric and option-centric paths that strengthens retrieval and mitigates cascading failures caused by missing foundational knowledge. We then develop cognition-stratified Constrained Reasoning, which replaces unconstrained chain-of-thought generation with structured templates to reduce logical inconsistency and generative redundancy. Experiments on two representative models, Qwen3-8B and Llama3.1-8B, show that CogRAG+ consistently outperforms general-purpose models and standard RAG methods on the Registered Dietitian qualification exam. In single-question mode, it raises overall accuracy to 85.8\% for Qwen3-8B and 60.3\% for Llama3.1-8B, with clear gains over vanilla baselines. Constrained Reasoning also reduces the unanswered rate from 7.6\% to 1.4\%. CogRAG+ offers a robust, model-agnostic path toward training-free expert-level performance in specialized domains.

AI.tldr: 提出CogRAG+框架，通过解耦检索与推理、引入强化检索和分层约束推理，在注册营养师考试中显著提升大模型的专业问答性能，无需额外训练。
AI.motivation: 现有大模型在专业领域任务中检索与推理紧密耦合，推理过程不透明，容易产生知识缺失和推理不一致的问题。
AI.method: 提出CogRAG+框架：1) Reinforced Retrieval：基于裁判驱动的双路径策略（事实中心路径和选项中心路径），增强检索能力，缓解级联失败；2) Cognition-stratified Constrained Reasoning：用结构化模板替代无约束思维链，减少逻辑不一致性和生成冗余。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-8B和Llama3.1-8B上，CogRAG+在注册营养师资格考试中优于通用模型和标准RAG方法。单问题模式下Qwen3-8B准确率提升至85.8%，Llama3.1-8B提升至60.3%；未回答率从7.6%降至1.4%。
AI.conclusion: CogRAG+是一种鲁棒、模型无关的免训练框架，能够在专业领域实现专家级别的性能。

title: Persuadability and LLMs as Legal Decision Tools
comment: Accepted to 21st International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Law (ICAIL 2026)
summary: As Large Language Models (LLMs) are proposed as legal decision assistants, and even first-instance decision-makers, across a range of judicial and administrative contexts, it becomes essential to explore how they answer legal questions, and in particular the factors that lead them to decide difficult questions in one way or another. A specific feature of legal decisions is the need to respond to arguments advanced by contending parties. A legal decision-maker must be able to engage with, and respond to, including through being potentially persuaded by, arguments advanced by the parties. Conversely, they should not be unduly persuadable, influenced by a particularly compelling advocate to decide cases based on the skills of the advocates, rather than the merits of the case. We explore how frontier open- and closed-weights LLMs respond to legal arguments, reporting original experimental results examining how the quality of the advocate making those arguments affects the likelihood that a model will agree with a particular legal point of view, and exploring the factors driving these results. Our results have implications for the feasibility of adopting LLMs across legal and administrative settings.

AI.tldr: 本研究探究了大型语言模型（LLMs）在司法决策中对法律论据的响应方式，特别关注辩护人论证质量是否会影响模型的法律判断。实验结果表明，LLMs可能被高质量辩护者过度说服，从而影响其基于案件实质做出公正裁决的能力。
AI.motivation: LLMs被提议作为法律决策助手甚至一审决策者，但其在面对法律争议（尤其是双方论据对抗时）的决策机制尚不明确。法律决策需要既能听取并响应论据，又不应被辩护技巧过度影响。因此，研究LLMs在何种程度上受辩护人质量影响至关重要。
AI.method: 通过实验方法，考察前沿开源和闭源权重的LLMs如何回应法律论据，系统探究辩护人论证质量（quality of advocate）对模型同意特定法律观点概率的影响，并分析驱动该结果的因素。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，LLMs的决策确实受到辩护人论据质量的影响，存在被高质量辩护者过度说服的现象，这可能偏离基于案件实质的公正决策原则。
AI.conclusion: 该发现对在司法和行政场景中采用LLMs的可行性提出了重要警示，表明模型在法律决策中可能受辩护技巧而非案件实质影响，需要进一步研究如何确保LLMs的法律判断公正性。

title: Sample Selection Using Multi-Task Autoencoders in Federated Learning with Non-IID Data
comment: Published in Engineering Science and Technology, an International Journal, 61 (2025), 101920. DOI: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jestch.2024.101920 and Codes: https://github.com/eardic/FL_DPQS
summary: Federated learning is a machine learning paradigm in which multiple devices collaboratively train a model under the supervision of a central server while ensuring data privacy. However, its performance is often hindered by redundant, malicious, or abnormal samples, leading to model degradation and inefficiency. To overcome these issues, we propose novel sample selection methods for image classification, employing a multitask autoencoder to estimate sample contributions through loss and feature analysis. Our approach incorporates unsupervised outlier detection, using one-class support vector machine (OCSVM), isolation forest (IF), and adaptive loss threshold (AT) methods managed by a central server to filter noisy samples on clients. We also propose a multi-class deep support vector data description (SVDD) loss controlled by a central server to enhance feature-based sample selection. We validate our methods on CIFAR10 and MNIST datasets across varying numbers of clients, non-IID distributions, and noise levels up to 40%. The results show significant accuracy improvements with loss-based sample selection, achieving gains of up to 7.02% on CIFAR10 with OCSVM and 1.83% on MNIST with AT. Additionally, our federated SVDD loss further improves feature-based sample selection, yielding accuracy gains of up to 0.99% on CIFAR10 with OCSVM. These results show the effectiveness of our methods in improving model accuracy across various client counts and noise conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于多任务自编码器和无监督异常检测（OCSVM、隔离森林、自适应损失阈值）的联邦学习样本选择方法，通过损失和特征分析过滤噪声样本，在CIFAR10和MNIST数据集上最高提升准确率7.02%。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习中冗余、恶意或异常样本导致模型性能下降，现有方法缺乏有效的样本选择机制来过滤噪声数据。
AI.method: 提出基于多任务自编码器的样本贡献评估方法，结合OCSVM、隔离森林、自适应损失阈值等无监督异常检测方法，以及多类深度SVDD损失，由中央服务器控制实现客户端样本过滤。
AI.result: 在CIFAR10上使用OCSVM损失过滤最高提升7.02%准确率，MNIST上AT方法提升1.83%；特征选择方面SVDD损失在CIFAR10上提升0.99%。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法在不同客户端数量、非IID分布和高达40%噪声条件下均能有效提升模型准确率。

title: LLMs Generate Kitsch
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used to generate pictures, texts, music, videos, and other works that have traditionally required human creativity. LLM-generated artifacts are often rated better than human-generated works in controlled studies. At the same time, they can come across as generic and hollow. We propose to resolve this tension by arguing that LLMs systematically generate kitsch, and that this is a consequence of the way in which they are trained. We also show empirically that readers perceive LLM-generated stories as kitschier, if we control for their definition of "kitsch". We discuss implications for the design of future studies and for creative tasks such as research and coding.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出，大型语言模型（LLMs）系统性地生成“刻奇”（kitsch）作品，这是由其训练方式导致的，并通过实证研究证明读者认为LLM生成的故事更“刻奇”。
AI.motivation: 现有研究存在矛盾：LLM生成的作品在控制研究中往往被评价为优于人类作品，但同时可能显得“千篇一律”和“空洞”。作者试图通过“刻奇”概念来解释这一张力。
AI.method: 首先从理论上论证LLM训练方式导致其系统性地生成刻奇作品；然后通过实证研究，在控制受试者对“刻奇”定义的前提下，让读者评估LLM生成与人类创作的故事。
AI.result: 实证结果显示，当控制受试者对“刻奇”的定义后，读者确实认为LLM生成的故事比人类创作的故事更“刻奇”。
AI.conclusion: LLM生成内容的内在“刻奇”特性对未来研究设计以及研究、编程等创造性任务有重要启示。

title: Apriori-based Analysis of Learned Helplessness in Mathematics Tutoring: Behavioral Patterns by Level, Intervention, and Outcome
summary: This study applied the Apriori algorithm to analyze behavioral interaction patterns associated with learned helplessness (LH) in mathematics tutoring system logs. Interaction data were examined across three dimensions: LH level (low vs. high), system-based intervention (with vs. without), and problem-solving outcomes (solved vs. unsolved). The analysis of the complete dataset showed that skipping problems without using hints was the most frequent pattern linked to unsolved outcomes, while persistence behaviors such as not skipping were less dominant overall. Comparisons by LH level showed that low-LH students had stronger links between problem solving and not skipping, as well as positive associations between hint use and solved outcomes. High-LH students showed more avoidance patterns, with skipping strongly tied to unsolved outcomes. In the comparison of system-based intervention conditions, students without intervention had the highest lift for persistence-success links, while the with-intervention group had stronger patterns involving skipping behaviors leading to unsolved outcomes. Outcome-specific analysis showed that not skipping was consistently associated with solved problems across all groups, while skipping without hints predicted unsolved outcomes. Practical implications and recommendations are discussed.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用Apriori算法分析数学辅导系统日志中与习得性无助相关的行为交互模式，发现跳过问题而不使用提示是最常见的未解决结果模式，而坚持行为（如不跳过）整体较少。低LH学生表现出更强的解决问题与坚持行为之间的正向关联，高LH学生则更多表现为回避模式。无干预组在坚持-成功关联上提升度最高，有干预组则表现出更强的跳过-未解决模式。
AI.motivation: 探究数学辅导系统中学生的习得性无助行为模式，理解不同LH水平、系统干预条件和问题解决结果下学生行为交互的差异，为教育干预提供数据支持。
AI.method: 使用Apriori算法对数学辅导系统日志中的行为交互数据进行分析，从LH水平（低vs高）、系统干预（有vs无）和问题解决结果（已解决vs未解决）三个维度进行关联规则挖掘。
AI.result: 跳过问题而不使用提示是与未解决结果最频繁关联的模式；低LH学生表现出更强的坚持-解决问题正向关联及提示使用-成功关联；高LH学生表现出更多回避模式；无干预组在坚持-成功关联上提升度最高，有干预组则跳过行为与未解决结果关联更强。
AI.conclusion: 不同LH水平和干预条件下学生表现出差异化的行为模式，研究结果为针对性地设计干预策略以缓解习得性无助提供了实践建议。

title: Associative-State Universal Transformers: Sparse Retrieval Meets Structured Recurrence
summary:
We study whether a structured recurrent state can serve as a compact associative backbone for language modeling while still supporting exact retrieval. We introduce UniMatrix, a Universal Transformer style family that reuses a shared recurrent block across depth and augments it with hybrid state updates, a ROSA-style residual path, and token-conditioned embedding modulation. We evaluate these models on byte-level WikiText-2, synthetic associative recall, throughput profiling on Apple MPS, and a corrected benchmark for triple-token interactions.
  At small scale, UniMatrix-Core and UniMatrix-ROSA slightly outperform a parameter-matched Transformer on WikiText-2 while using many fewer parameters, reaching 5.084 and 5.083 bits-per-byte versus 5.124. The main negative result is equally important: on associative recall, the original UniMatrix family remains near chance while the Transformer reaches 25.4 percent, showing that compressed recurrent state alone is not enough for exact lookup. A retrieval-oriented follow-up, UniMatrix-Assoc, helps only marginally. By contrast, UniMatrix-SparsePointer, which adds sparse slot routing and direct pointer-logit fusion, reaches 75.6 percent on the original pilot recipe and 99.2 percent on a no-dropout follow-up while using 53.8 percent fewer parameters than the Transformer baseline. Ablations show that the gain comes from sufficient slot capacity and exact pointer-level output routing. Overall, structured recurrent state is promising and parameter-efficient, but strong long-range behavior still requires explicit sparse retrieval and better kernels.

AI.tldr: 本文提出UniMatrix系列模型，探索结构化循环状态能否作为语言建模的紧凑关联骨干。结果表明纯循环状态在联想召回任务上接近随机水平，而结合稀疏指针检索的变体可大幅提升至99.2%准确率，同时减少53.8%参数。
AI.motivation: 研究结构化循环状态是否既能作为语言建模的紧凑关联骨干，又能支持精确检索。
AI.method: 提出UniMatrix系列，包括UniMatrix-Core、UniMatrix-ROSA、UniMatrix-Assoc和UniMatrix-SparsePointer，采用共享循环块、混合状态更新、残差路径及稀疏路由与指针融合机制。
AI.result: UniMatrix-Core/ROSA在WikiText-2上略优于Transformer（5.084/5.083 vs 5.124），但原始模型联想召回准确率接近随机；UniMatrix-SparsePointer达到75.6%-99.2%召回率，参数减少53.8%。
AI.conclusion: 结构化循环状态在参数效率上有潜力，但强长程行为仍需显式稀疏检索和更好的内核支持。

title: DreamProver: Evolving Transferable Lemma Libraries via a Wake-Sleep Theorem-Proving Agent
summary: We introduce DreamProver, an agentic framework that leverages a "wake-sleep" program induction paradigm to discover reusable lemmas for formal theorem proving. Existing approaches either rely on fixed lemma libraries, which limit adaptability, or synthesize highly specific intermediate lemmas tailored to individual theorems, thereby lacking generality. DreamProver addresses this gap through an iterative two-stage process. In the wake stage, DreamProver attempts to prove theorems from a training set using the current lemma library while proposing new candidate lemmas. In the "sleep" stage, it abstracts, refines, and consolidates these candidates to compress and optimize the library. Through this alternating cycle, DreamProver progressively evolves a compact set of high-level, transferable lemmas that can be effectively used to prove unseen theorems in related domains. Experimental results demonstrate that DreamProver substantially improves proof success rates across a diverse set of mathematical benchmarks, while also producing more concise proofs and reducing computational cost.

AI.tldr: DreamProver 是一个基于"醒-睡"程序归纳范式的智能体框架，通过迭代两阶段过程自动发现可复用的引理，显著提升形式化定理证明的成功率、简洁性和计算效率。
AI.motivation: 现有方法要么依赖固定的引理库导致适应性有限，要么为单个定理合成高度特化的引理缺乏通用性，缺乏一种能够自动发现可迁移、可复用引理的方法。
AI.method: 采用"醒-睡"两阶段迭代范式：清醒阶段使用当前引理库尝试证明训练集中的定理并提出新候选引理；睡眠阶段对这些候选引理进行抽象、精炼和整合，压缩并优化引理库。通过交替循环逐步演化出一组紧凑、高层次、可迁移的引理。
AI.result: 在多个数学基准上，DreamProver 显著提高了证明成功率，生成了更简洁的证明，并降低了计算成本。
AI.conclusion: DreamProver 通过迭代式引理发现与压缩机制，有效弥合了固定引理库与特化引理之间的鸿沟，为形式化定理证明提供了一种更通用、高效的解决方案。

title: Anchored Confabulation: Partial Evidence Non-Monotonically Amplifies Confident Hallucination in LLMs
summary: We identify a previously unknown calibration property of large language models: providing one confirmed intermediate fact toward a multi-step reasoning chain increases the model's confident-wrong-answer rate before full evidence eliminates it. We call this anchored confabulation: a partial anchor commits the model to confident parametric completion of remaining reasoning steps. We formalize it as Parametric Hallucination Confidence (PHC) and establish it across six lines of evidence including a causal injection experiment (PHC 0.613 to 0.656 to 0.595 to 0.536, N=160) and capability scaling across five model families (Spearman rho=0.900, p=0.037). The Anchoring Threshold Law k*(n)=floor(n/3) predicts PHC amplification by hop depth with four confirmed predictions. Applied to RAG routing, a LearnedRouter exploiting PHC closes 81.1% of the oracle performance gap (macro F1=0.426, p<1e-6) on 1,800 queries across four benchmarks with no model fine-tuning and 50x fewer labels than prior RL-based work. An epistemic humility prompt reduces the PHC spike by -0.118; explicit self-rating (PHC=0.684, p<0.001) outperforms lexical confidence as a routing signal.

AI.tldr: 本文发现大语言模型在多步推理中存在一种新的校准偏差：当模型获得一个确认的中间事实时，其自信错误回答率会上升，直到完整证据消除这一现象。作者将其命名为"锚定虚构"（Anchored Confabulation），并提出参数化幻觉置信度（PHC）进行量化，通过因果注入实验、能力缩放分析、锚定阈值定律等六条证据线加以验证。基于该发现，他们设计了无需微调的RAG路由策略和认知谦逊提示来缓解问题。
AI.motivation: 揭示大语言模型在部分证据下产生的反直觉置信度偏差，即"锚定虚构"现象，以理解模型推理中的隐藏校准缺陷。
AI.method: 通过因果注入实验（PHC从0.613到0.656再到0.595最后到0.536，N=160）、跨五个模型家族的能力缩放分析（Spearman rho=0.900, p=0.037）、锚定阈值定律k*(n)=floor(n/3)预测、RAG路由应用（LearnedRouter，宏F1=0.426, p<1e-6）及认知谦逊提示等方法进行验证。
AI.result: 实验证实了锚定虚构的存在，锚定阈值定律成功预测了PHC随推理深度放大；LearnedRouter在1800个查询上以50倍少于RL方法的标签量达到了81.1%的oracle性能差距；认知谦逊提示将PHC峰值降低-0.118；显式自我评分作为路由信号优于词汇置信度。
AI.conclusion: 锚定虚构是大语言模型推理中一种系统性的校准偏差，可被量化、预测并缓解。该发现对检索增强生成（RAG）路由和模型自我评估具有重要实践意义。

title: Auto-Relational Reasoning
summary: Background & Objectives: In the last decade, Machine learning research has grown rapidly, but large models are reaching their soft limits demonstrating diminishing returns and still lack solid reasoning abilities. These limits could be surpassed through synergistic combination of Machine Learning scalability and rigid reasoning. Methods: In this work, we propose a theoretical framework for reasoning through object-relations in an automated manner integrated with Artificial Neural Networks. We present a formal analysis of the Reasoning, and we show the theory in practice through a paradigm integrating Reasoning and Machine Learning. Results: This paradigm is a system that solves Intelligence Quotient problems without any prior knowledge of the problem. Our system achieves 98.03% solving rate corresponding to the top 1% percentile or 132-144 iq score. This result is only limited by the small size of the model and the processing capabilities of the machine it run on. Conclusions: With the integration of prior knowledge in the system and the expansion of the dataset, the system can be generalized to solve a large category of problems. The functionality of the system inherently favors the solution of such problems in few-shot or zero-shot attempts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种将机器学习的可扩展性与严格推理相结合的理论框架，通过对象-关系的自动化推理与人工神经网络集成，在无先验知识的情况下解决IQ问题，达到98.03%的解决率（对应IQ 132-144，前1%）。
AI.motivation: 大型机器学习模型虽发展迅速但已接近软极限，表现出收益递减且缺乏稳固的推理能力，因此需要通过机器学习可扩展性与严格推理的协同组合来突破这些极限。
AI.method: 提出一个通过对象-关系进行自动化推理的理论框架，并将其与人工神经网络集成；对该推理过程进行形式化分析，并通过一个集成推理与机器学习的范式在实践中展示该理论。
AI.result: 系统在无先验知识的情况下解决IQ问题，达到98.03%的解决率，对应前1%分位或IQ 132-144。该结果仅受限于模型规模小和机器处理能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过将先验知识整合到系统中并扩展数据集，该系统可以泛化解决更大类别的问题，其功能特性天然适合少样本或零样本的问题求解。

title: Why Domain Matters: A Preliminary Study of Domain Effects in Underwater Object Detection
comment: Poster Presentation at ICRA 2026 Workshop S2S
summary: Domain shift, where deviations between training and deployment data distributions degrade model performance, is a key challenge in underwater environments. Existing benchmarks testing performance for underwater domain shift simulate variability through synthetic style transfer. This fails to capture intrinsic scene factors such as visibility, illumination, scene composition, or acquisition factors, limiting analysis of real-world effects. We propose a labeling framework that defines underwater domains using measurable image, scene, and acquisition characteristics. Unlike prior benchmarks, it captures physically meaningful factors, enabling semantically consistent image grouping and supporting domain-specific evaluation of detection performance including failure analysis. We validate this on public datasets, showing systematic variations across domain factors and revealing hidden failure modes.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于可测量图像、场景和采集特征的标签框架来定义水下领域，替代传统合成风格迁移方法，能够捕获物理有意义的因素，实现语义一致的图像分组，并支持领域特定的目标检测性能评估和故障分析。
AI.motivation: 现有水下领域迁移基准通过合成风格迁移模拟变化，无法捕捉可见度、光照、场景构成等真实场景因素，限制了对真实世界影响的分析。
AI.method: 提出一种标签框架，使用可测量的图像、场景和采集特征定义水下领域，实现语义一致的图像分组，支持领域特定的检测性能评估和故障分析。
AI.result: 在公开数据集上验证，展示了跨领域因素的系统性变化，并揭示了隐藏的故障模式。
AI.conclusion: 该框架相比传统合成风格迁移方法，能更真实地反映水下环境中的领域偏移问题，有助于发现传统方法无法揭示的故障模式。

title: Training Computer Use Agents to Assess the Usability of Graphical User Interfaces
summary: Usability testing with experts and potential users can assess the effectiveness, efficiency, and user satisfaction of graphical user interfaces (GUIs) but doing so remains a costly and time-intensive process. Prior work has used computer use agents (CUAs) and other generative agents that can simulate user interactions and preference, but we show that agents still struggle to provide accurate usability assessments. In this work, we present a novel machine learning method that operationalizes a computational definition of usability to train CUAs to assess GUI usability by i) prioritizing important interaction flows, ii) executing them through human-like interactions, and iii) predicting a learned numerical usability score. We train a computer use agent, uxCUA, with our algorithm on a large-scale dataset of fully interactive user interfaces (UIs) paired with usability labels and human preferences. We show that uxCUA outperforms larger models in accurate usability assessments and produces realistic critiques of both synthetic and real UIs. More broadly, our work aims to build a principled, data-driven foundation for automated usability assessment in HCI.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为uxCUA的机器学习方法，通过计算化可用性定义训练计算机使用智能体，使其能够通过优先交互流程、类人交互和执行数值评分，更准确地评估GUI可用性，且优于大型模型。
AI.motivation: 传统的可用性测试虽然有效，但成本高且耗时；现有的计算机使用智能体在提供准确可用性评估方面仍存在困难。
AI.method: 提出一种新颖的机器学习方法，将可用性的计算定义操作化，通过三个步骤训练CUA：i) 优先考虑重要的交互流程，ii) 以类人方式执行交互，iii) 预测学习到的数值化可用性评分。在包含交互式UI、可用性标签和人类偏好的大规模数据集上训练名为uxCUA的智能体。
AI.result: uxCUA在准确可用性评估方面优于更大的模型，并能对合成和真实UI产生逼真的评价。
AI.conclusion: 该工作旨在为人机交互中的自动化可用性评估建立原则性的、数据驱动的基础。

title: Grounding vs. Compositionality: On the Non-Complementarity of Reasoning in Neuro-Symbolic Systems
summary: Compositional generalization remains a foundational weakness of modern neural networks, limiting their robustness and applicability in domains requiring out-of-distribution reasoning. A central, yet unverified, assumption in neuro-symbolic AI is that compositional reasoning will emerge as a byproduct of successful symbol grounding. This work presents the first systematic empirical analysis to challenge this assumption by disentangling the contributions of grounding and reasoning. To operationalize this investigation, we introduce the Iterative Logic Tensor Network ($i$LTN), a fully differentiable architecture designed for multi-step deduction. Using a formal taxonomy of generalization -- probing for novel entities, unseen relations, and complex rule compositions -- we demonstrate that a model trained solely on a grounding objective fails to generalize. In contrast, our full $i$LTN, trained jointly on perceptual grounding and multi-step reasoning, achieves high zero-shot accuracy across all tasks. Our findings provide conclusive evidence that symbol grounding, while necessary, is insufficient for generalization, establishing that reasoning is not an emergent property but a distinct capability that requires an explicit learning objective.

AI.tldr: 本文首次通过系统性实验证明，符号接地（symbol grounding）虽然必要，但不足以实现组合泛化；推理能力并非神经网络的涌现特性，而是需要明确学习目标才能获得的独立能力。
AI.motivation: 神经符号AI领域长期存在一个未经检验的前提假设：成功的符号接地会自动催生组合推理能力。本文旨在挑战这一假设。
AI.method: 提出全可微分的迭代逻辑张量网络（$i$LTN），用于多步演绎推理；通过解耦接地与推理的贡献，并构建形式化泛化分类体系（新实体、未见关系、复杂规则组合）进行实证分析。
AI.result: 仅训练接地目标的模型在所有泛化任务上均失败；而联合训练接地与多步推理的完整$i$LTN在所有任务上实现了高零样本准确率。
AI.conclusion: 符号接地不足以实现泛化，推理不是涌现属性，而是一种需要单独优化目标的独立能力。

title: Lifting Embodied World Models for Planning and Control
summary: World models of embodied agents predict future observations conditioned on an action taken by the agent. For complex embodiments, action spaces are high-dimensional and difficult to specify: for example, precisely controlling a human agent requires specifying the motion of each joint. This makes the world model hard to control and expensive to plan with as search-based methods like CEM scale poorly with action dimensionality. To address this issue, we train a lightweight policy that maps high-level actions to sequences of low-level joint actions. Composing this policy with the frozen world model produces a lifted world model that predicts a sequence of future observations from a single high-level action. We instantiate this framework for a human-like embodiment, defining the high-level action space as a small set of 2D waypoints annotated on the current observation frame, each specifying a near-term goal position for a leaf joint (pelvis, head, hands). Waypoints are low-dimensional, visually interpretable, and easy to specify manually or to search over. We show that the lifted world model substantially outperforms searching directly in low-level joint space ($3.8\times$ lower mean joint error to the goal pose), while remaining more compute-efficient and generalizing to environments unseen by the policy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种提升世界模型（Lifted World Model），通过轻量级策略将高层动作映射为低层关节动作序列，解决了高维动作空间下世界模型难以控制和规划的问题。在类人体现上，用2D路点作为高层动作，相比直接搜索低层关节空间，联合误差降低3.8倍，且计算效率更高、泛化性更好。
AI.motivation: 具身智能体的世界模型需要预测未来观测，但复杂体现（如人体）的动作空间高维且难以指定，导致模型难以控制且基于搜索的规划方法（如CEM）扩展性差。
AI.method: 训练一个轻量级策略，将高层动作映射为低层关节动作序列，再与冻结的世界模型组合成提升世界模型。高层动作定义为当前观测帧上的2D路点，指定近端目标位置（骨盆、头部、手部）。
AI.result: 提升世界模型相比直接搜索低层关节空间，平均联合误差降低3.8倍，计算效率更高，且能泛化到策略未见过的环境。
AI.conclusion: 使用低维、可视觉解释的高层动作空间（2D路点）能有效缓解高维动作空间带来的控制与规划困难，提升世界模型性能与实用性。

title: AGEL-Comp: A Neuro-Symbolic Framework for Compositional Generalization in Interactive Agents
summary: Large Language Model (LLM)-based agents exhibit systemic failures in compositional generalization, limiting their robustness in interactive environments. This work introduces AGEL-Comp, a neuro-symbolic AI agent architecture designed to address this challenge by grounding actions of the agent. AGEL-Comp integrates three core innovations: (1) a dynamic Causal Program Graph (CPG) as a world model, representing procedural and causal knowledge as a directed hypergraph; (2) an Inductive Logic Programming (ILP) engine that synthesizes new Horn clauses from experiential feedback, grounding symbolic knowledge through interaction; and (3) a hybrid reasoning core where an LLM proposes a set of candidate sub-goals that are verified for logical consistency by a Neural Theorem Prover (NTP). Together, these components operationalize a deduction--abduction learning cycle: enabling the agent to deduce plans and abductively expand its symbolic world model, while a neural adaptation phase keeps its reasoning engine aligned with new knowledge. We propose an evaluation protocol within the \texttt{Retro Quest} simulation environment to probe for compositional generalization scenarios to evaluate our AGEL agent. Our findings clearly indicate the better performance of our AGEL model over pure LLM-based models. Our framework presents a principled path toward agents that build an explicit, interpretable, and compositionally structured understanding of their world.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AGEL-Comp神经符号智能体架构，通过动态因果程序图、归纳逻辑编程引擎和混合推理核心，解决LLM智能体在组合泛化中的系统性失败问题，在Retro Quest环境中表现优于纯LLM模型。
AI.motivation: 基于LLM的智能体在组合泛化方面存在系统性失败，限制了其在交互环境中的鲁棒性，需要一种能够构建显式、可解释且组合结构化世界理解的新型架构。
AI.method: AGEL-Comp架构包含三个核心创新：(1) 动态因果程序图(CPG)作为世界模型；(2) 归纳逻辑编程(ILP)引擎从经验反馈中合成新Horn子句；(3) 混合推理核心，由LLM提出候选子目标，神经定理证明器(NTP)验证逻辑一致性。三者实现演绎-溯因学习循环。
AI.result: 在Retro Quest模拟环境中，AGEL模型在组合泛化场景下的表现明显优于纯LLM模型。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为构建具有显式、可解释且组合结构化世界理解的智能体提供了一条有原则的路径。

title: Privacy-Preserving Clothing Classification using Vision Transformer for Thermal Comfort Estimation
comment: To be appeared in 2026 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics - Taiwan (ICCE-TW 2026)
summary: A privacy-preserving clothing classification scheme is presented to enable secure occupant-centric control (OCC) systems. Although the utilization of camera images for HVAC control has been widely studied to optimize thermal comfort, privacy protection of occupant images has not been considered in prior works. While various privacy-preserving methods have been proposed for image classification, applying conventional schemes results in severe accuracy degradation. In this paper, we introduce a privacy-preserving classification method using Vision Transformer (ViT) applied to clothing insulation estimation. In an experiment using the DeepFashion dataset categorized by clothing insulation, while the conventional pixel-based method suffers a severe accuracy drop, our scheme maintains a high accuracy on encrypted images, showing no degradation from plain images across all categories.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于Vision Transformer (ViT)的隐私保护衣物分类方案，用于安全的人体中心控制（OCC）系统，在加密图像上实现了与明文图像相当的分类精度。
AI.motivation: 现有利用摄像头图像优化暖通空调（HVAC）控制的研究未考虑用户图像隐私保护，而传统隐私保护方法应用于图像分类时会导致严重的精度下降。
AI.method: 采用Vision Transformer (ViT)对加密图像进行衣物隔热等级分类，替代传统像素级方法。
AI.result: 在DeepFashion数据集上，所提方案在加密图像上保持了高分类精度，与明文图像相比无精度下降；而传统像素级方法在加密图像上精度显著下降。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的ViT隐私保护分类方案在保护图像隐私的同时，有效避免了传统方法面临的精度退化问题，适用于安全的OCC系统。

title: From Prompt Risk to Response Risk: Paired Analysis of Safety Behavior of Large Language Model
summary: Safety evaluations of large language models (LLMs) typically report binary outcomes such as attack success rate, refusal rate, or harmful/not-harmful response classification. While useful, these can hide how risk changes between a user's input and the model's response. We present a paired, transition-based analysis over 1250 prompt-response records with human-provided labels over four harm categories (Hate, Sexual, Violence, Self-harm) and ordinal severity levels aligned with the Azure AI Content Safety taxonomy. 61% of responses de-escalate harm relative to the prompt, 36% preserve the same severity, and 3% escalate to higher harm. A per-category persistence/drift-up decomposition identifies Sexual content as 3x harder to de-escalate than Hate or Violence, driven by persistence on already-sexual prompts, not by newly introducing sexual harm from benign inputs. Jointly measuring response relevance reveals an empirical signature of the helpfulness-harmlessness tradeoff: all compliance-escalation cases (from non-zero prompts) are relevance-3 (high-quality, on-task content at elevated severity), while medium-severity responses show the lowest relevance (64%), driven by tangential elaborations in Violence and Sexual categories.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于状态转移的细粒度安全分析方法，对1250条提示-响应对进行人工标注，发现61%的回答降低了危害等级，36%保持不变，3%升高了危害等级。其中性内容比仇恨/暴力难降级3倍，且所有合规升级案例都是高质量但有害的响应，揭示了帮助性与无害性之间的权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM安全评估仅输出二元结果（如攻击成功率、拒绝率），无法揭示从用户输入到模型回答之间风险如何变化，因此需要更细粒度的过渡态分析。
AI.method: 对1250条提示-响应对进行人工标注，采用Azure AI内容安全分类法的四个危害类别（仇恨、性、暴力、自残）及序数严重等级，进行配对的状态转移分析，并联合测量响应相关性。
AI.result: 61%的回答降低危害等级，36%保持不变，3%升高；性内容降级难度是仇恨/暴力的3倍；所有合规升级案例均为高相关性的有害响应；中等严重等级的响应相关性最低（64%），主要由暴力和性类别中的离题扩展导致。
AI.conclusion: 二元安全指标会掩盖重要的风险动态变化，基于状态转移的细粒度分析能更准确揭示不同危害类别的降级难度差异以及帮助性与无害性之间的权衡关系。

title: FASH-iCNN: Making Editorial Fashion Identity Inspectable Through Multimodal CNN Probing
summary: Fashion AI systems routinely encode the aesthetic logic of specific houses, editors, and historical moments without disclosing it. We present FASH-iCNN, a multimodal system trained on 87,547 Vogue runway images across 15 fashion houses spanning 1991-2024 that makes this cultural logic inspectable. Given a photograph of a garment, the system recovers which house produced it, which era it belongs to, and which color tradition it reflects. A clothing-only model identifies the fashion house at 78.2% top-1 across 14 houses, the decade at 88.6% top-1, and the specific year at 58.3% top-1 across 34 years with a mean error of just 2.2 years. Probing which visual channels carry this signal reveals a sharp dissociation: removing color costs only 10.6pp of house identity accuracy, while removing texture costs 37.6pp, establishing texture and luminance as the primary carriers of editorial identity. FASH-iCNN treats editorial culture as the signal rather than background noise, identifying which houses, eras, and color traditions shaped each output so that users can see not just what the system predicts but which houses, editors, and historical moments are encoded in that prediction.

AI.tldr: FASH-iCNN是一个多模态系统，通过分析87,547张Vogue runway图像，能够识别服装所属的品牌、年代和色彩传统，并将编辑文化视为可检测的信号而非背景噪音。
AI.motivation: 现有的时尚AI系统隐含地编码了特定品牌、编辑和时代的审美逻辑，但并未将其透明化，用户无法了解模型预测背后所蕴含的文化信息。
AI.method: 构建了FASH-iCNN多模态系统，基于1991-2024年间15个时尚品牌的87,547张Vogue runway图像进行训练。通过消融实验（去除颜色/纹理通道）探究视觉特征对识别准确率的影响。
AI.result: 服装单独模型在14个品牌中top-1准确率78.2%，年代识别88.6%，年份识别58.3%，平均误差仅2.2年。去除颜色仅降低10.6pp品牌识别率，而去除纹理降低37.6pp，表明纹理和亮度是编辑身份的主要载体。
AI.conclusion: FASH-iCNN将编辑文化视为信号而非背景噪音，使系统预测结果透明化，用户可以了解哪些品牌、编辑和时代塑造了每个输出结果。

title: HIVE: Hidden-Evidence Verification for Hallucination Detection in Diffusion Large Language Models
summary: Diffusion large language models generate text through multi-step denoising, where hallucination signals may emerge throughout the trajectory rather than only in the final output. Existing detectors mainly rely on output uncertainty or coarse trace statistics, which often fail to capture the richer hidden dynamics of D-LLMs. We propose HIVE, a hidden-evidence verification framework that extracts compressed hidden evidence from denoising trajectories, selects informative step-layer evidence, and conditions a verifier language model on the selected evidence through prefix embeddings. HIVE produces both a continuous hallucination score from verifier decision logits and structured verification outputs, including hallucination types, evidence pairs, and short rationales. Across two D-LLMs and three QA benchmarks, HIVE consistently outperforms eight strong baselines and achieves up to 0.9236 AUROC and 0.9537 AUPRC. Ablation studies further confirm the importance of hidden-evidence conditioning, learned evidence selection, two-stream evidence representation, and step-layer embeddings. These results suggest that selected hidden evidence from denoising trajectories provides a stronger and more usable hallucination signal than output-only uncertainty or coarse trace statistics.

AI.tldr: 提出HIVE框架，利用扩散大模型的去噪轨迹中的隐藏证据进行幻觉检测，在多个基准测试中优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有幻觉检测器主要依赖输出不确定性或粗粒度的轨迹统计，无法捕捉扩散大模型在去噪过程中产生的丰富隐藏动态信息。
AI.method: HIVE框架包含三个步骤：(1) 从去噪轨迹中提取压缩的隐藏证据；(2) 选择信息量丰富的步骤-层证据；(3) 通过前缀嵌入将选定证据条件化输入到验证器语言模型中，输出连续幻觉分数及结构化验证结果。
AI.result: 在两个扩散大模型和三个问答基准上，HIVE一致优于八个强基线方法，最高达到0.9236 AUROC和0.9537 AUPRC。
AI.conclusion: 去噪轨迹中选择的隐藏证据相比仅依赖输出不确定性或粗粒度轨迹统计，能够提供更强且更可用的幻觉信号。

title: ViBE: Visual-to-M/EEG Brain Encoding via Spatio-Temporal VAE and Distribution-Aligned Projection
summary: Brain encoding models not only serve to decipher how visual stimuli are transformed into neural responses, but also represent a critical step toward visual prostheses that restore vision for patients with severe vision disorders. Brain encoding involves two fundamental steps: achieving faithful reconstruction of neural responses and establishing cross-modal alignment between visual stimuli and neural responses. To this end, we propose ViBE, a novel brain encoding framework for generating magnetoencephalography (MEG) and electroencephalography (EEG) signals from visual stimuli. Specifically, we first design a spatio-temporal convolutional variational autoencoder (TSC-VAE) that captures the spatio-temporal characteristics of M/EEG signals for effective neural response reconstruction. To bridge the modality gap between visual features and neural representations, we employ Q-Former to map CLIP image embeddings to the TSC-VAE latent space, producing neural proxy embeddings. For comprehensive cross-modal alignment, we combine mean squared error (MSE) loss for point-wise feature matching with sliced Wasserstein distance (SWD) for probability distribution alignment between the neural proxy embeddings and TSC-VAE latent embeddings. We conduct extensive experiments on the THINGS-EEG2 and THINGS-MEG datasets, demonstrating the effectiveness of our approach in generating high-quality M/EEG signals from visual stimuli.

AI.tldr: ViBE是一个新颖的脑编码框架，通过时空卷积变分自编码器（TSC-VAE）和Q-Former跨模态对齐技术，从视觉刺激生成高质量的M/EEG信号。
AI.motivation: 脑编码模型不仅有助于理解视觉刺激如何转化为神经反应，也是实现视觉假体功能的关键步骤，旨在为严重视力障碍患者恢复视觉。
AI.method: 提出ViBE框架：1) 设计时空卷积变分自编码器（TSC-VAE）捕捉M/EEG信号的时空特征；2) 使用Q-Former将CLIP图像嵌入映射到TSC-VAE潜在空间，生成神经代理嵌入；3) 结合MSE损失（逐点特征匹配）和切片Wasserstein距离SWD（概率分布对齐）进行跨模态对齐。
AI.result: 在THINGS-EEG2和THINGS-MEG数据集上的广泛实验证明了该方法能从视觉刺激生成高质量M/EEG信号的有效性。
AI.conclusion: ViBE通过有效的神经反应重建和跨模态对齐，实现了从视觉刺激到M/EEG信号的忠实生成，为脑编码研究和视觉假体发展提供了新思路。

title: Structural Generalization on SLOG without Hand-Written Rules
summary: Structural generalization in semantic parsing requires systems to apply learned compositional rules to novel structural combinations. Existing approaches either rely on hand-written algebraic rules (AM-Parser) or fail to generalize structurally (Transformer-based models). We present an alternative requiring no hand-written compositional rules, based on a neural cellular automaton (NCA) with a discrete bottleneck: all compositional rules are learned from data through local iteration. On the SLOG benchmark, the system achieves 100% type-exact match on 11 of 17 structural generalization categories, including three where AM-Parser scores 0 to 74%, with an overall standard deviation of 0.2 across 10 seeds (vs. AM-Parser's 4.3). Analysis reveals that all 5,539 failure instances reduce to exactly two mechanisms: novel combinations of wh-extraction context with reduced verb types, and modifiers appearing on the subject side of verbs.When we decompose results by CCG structural features, each sub-pattern either succeeds on all instances or fails on all. Intermediate scores (e.g., 41.4%) are mixtures of structurally distinct CCG patterns, not partial generalization.All failures correspond to directed operations absent from training; all successes correspond to operations already covered.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于神经细胞自动机(NCA)的语义解析方法，无需手工编写组合规则，在SLOG基准测试中17个泛化类别中11个达到100%准确率，失败案例可归结为两种机制。
AI.motivation: 现有语义解析方法要么依赖手写代数规则(如AM-Parser)，要么在结构泛化上表现不佳(如Transformer模型)，需要一种无需手工规则且能良好泛化的替代方案。
AI.method: 采用神经细胞自动机(NCA)结合离散瓶颈，通过局部迭代从数据中学习所有组合规则，无需手工编写的组合规则。
AI.result: 在SLOG基准上，17个结构泛化类别中11个达到100%类型精确匹配；相比AM-Parser在3个类别上从0-74%提升至100%；10个种子的标准差仅0.2（AM-Parser为4.3）。所有5,539个失败实例归结为两种机制：wh-提取上下文与缩减动词类型的新组合、动词主语侧出现修饰语。
AI.conclusion: 基于NCA的方法能够有效学习组合规则实现结构泛化，失败案例均对应训练中缺失的有向操作，成功案例对应训练已覆盖的操作。

title: When to Vote, When to Rewrite: Disagreement-Guided Strategy Routing for Test-Time Scaling
summary: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) achieve strong performance on mathematical reasoning tasks but remain unreliable on challenging instances. Existing test-time scaling methods, such as repeated sampling, self-correction, and tree search, improve performance at the cost of increased computation, yet often exhibit diminishing returns on hard problems. We observe that output disagreement is strongly correlated with instance difficulty and prediction correctness, providing a useful signal for guiding instance-level strategy selection at test time. Based on this insight, we propose a training-free framework that formulates test-time scaling as an instance-level routing problem, rather than allocating more computation within a single strategy, dynamically selecting among different scaling strategies based on output disagreement. The framework applies lightweight resolution for consistent cases, majority voting for moderate disagreement, and rewriting-based reformulation for highly ambiguous instances. Experiments on seven mathematical benchmarks and three models show that our method improves accuracy by 3% - 7% while reducing sampling cost compared to existing approaches.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于输出不一致性度量的训练无关测试时扩展框架，通过实例级路由策略动态选择不同扩展方法，在提升数学推理准确率的同时降低计算成本。
AI.motivation: 现有测试时扩展方法（如重复采样、自我修正、树搜索）在困难问题上存在收益递减现象，且无法根据实例难度自适应调整策略。
AI.method: 基于输出不一致性（output disagreement）作为实例难度和预测正确性的信号，将测试时扩展建模为实例级路由问题：一致性高时轻量解析，中等不一致时多数投票，高度模糊时使用重写重构。
AI.result: 在7个数学基准和3个模型上，准确率提升3%-7%，同时采样成本低于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 输出不一致性可作为有效的实例级策略选择信号，训练无关的测试时路由框架在性能和效率之间取得了更好平衡。

title: Test-Time Safety Alignment
summary: Recent work has shown that a model's input word embeddings can serve as effective control variables for steering its behavior toward outputs that satisfy desired properties. However, this has only been demonstrated for pretrained text-completion models on the relatively simple objective of reducing surface-level profanity in short continuations. A natural and practically important question is how well input embeddings can control aligned models, which produce an imbalanced bimodal refuse-or-comply output distribution rather than the smooth distribution characteristic of open-ended generation. We explore this in the context of safety, showing that input word embeddings can be optimized in a sub-lexical manner to minimize the semantic harmfulness of aligned model responses. Our approach uses zeroth-order gradient estimation of a black-box text-moderation API with respect to the input embeddings, and then applies gradient descent on these embeddings to minimize the harmfulness of the generated text. Experiments show that the proposed method can neutralize every safety-flagged response on standard safety benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种通过优化输入词嵌入来降低对齐模型输出有害性的方法，能在标准安全基准上消除所有不安全响应。
AI.motivation: 已有研究表明输入词嵌入可控制预训练模型行为，但仅限于减少表面粗俗内容的简单任务。一个自然且实际重要的问题是：输入嵌入能否有效控制具有"拒绝-遵从"双峰分布的对齐模型的安全行为。
AI.method: 使用零阶梯度估计黑盒文本审核API对输入嵌入的梯度，然后对嵌入进行梯度下降优化，以次词元(sub-lexical)方式最小化生成文本的有害性。
AI.result: 该方法能在标准安全基准上消除每一个被安全标记的响应。
AI.conclusion: 输入词嵌入优化可以有效控制对齐模型的安全输出，即使面对原本会产生"拒绝-遵从"双峰分布的情况，也能有效降低有害性。

title: SciHorizon-DataEVA: An Agentic System for AI-Readiness Evaluation of Heterogeneous Scientific Data
summary: AI-for-Science (AI4Science) is increasingly transforming scientific discovery by embedding machine learning models into prediction, simulation, and hypothesis generation workflows across domains. However, the effectiveness of these models is fundamentally constrained by the AI-readiness of scientific data, for which no scalable and systematic evaluation mechanism currently exists. In this work, we propose SciHorizon-DataEVA, a novel agentic system to scalable AI-readiness evaluation of heterogeneous scientific data. At the evaluation-criteria level, we introduce the Sci-TQA2 principles, which organize AI-readiness into four complementary dimensions: Governance Trustworthiness, Data Quality, AI Compatibility, and Scientific Adaptability. Each dimension is decomposed into measurable atomic elements that enable fine-grained and executable assessment. To operationalize these principles at scale, we develop Sci-TQA2-Eval, a hierarchical multi-agent evaluation approach orchestrated through a directed, cyclic workflow. Our Sci-TQA2-Eval dynamically constructs dataset-aware evaluation specifications by combining lightweight dataset profiling, applicability-aware metric activation, and knowledge-augmented planning grounded in domain constraints and dataset-paper signals. These specifications are executed through an adaptive, tool-centric evaluation mechanism with built-in verification and self-correction, enabling scalable and reliable assessment across heterogeneous scientific data. Extensive experiments on scientific datasets spanning multiple domains demonstrate the effectiveness and generality of SciHorizon-DataEVA for principled AI-readiness evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SciHorizon-DataEVA，一个用于科学数据AI就绪度可扩展评估的智能系统，基于Sci-TQA2原则从治理可信度、数据质量、AI兼容性和科学适应性四个维度进行层次化多智能体评估。
AI.motivation: 当前缺乏可扩展且系统化的机制来评估科学数据对AI模型的有效支撑程度（即AI就绪度），这制约了AI4Science的发展。
AI.method: 提出Sci-TQA2原则（四大维度+可度量原子要素），并开发Sci-TQA2-Eval层次化多智能体评估方法，包含数据集画像、适用性指标激活、知识增强规划及带验证自纠正的自适应工具评估机制。
AI.result: 在跨领域科学数据集上的广泛实验验证了SciHorizon-DataEVA在原则化AI就绪度评估中的有效性和通用性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为异构科学数据的AI就绪度评估提供了首个可扩展的系统化方案，有望推动AI4Science中数据基础的标准化建设。

title: HOI-aware Adaptive Network for Weakly-supervised Action Segmentation
summary: In this paper, we propose an HOI-aware adaptive network named AdaAct for weakly-supervised action segmentation. Most existing methods learn a fixed network to predict the action of each frame with the neighboring frames. However, this would result in ambiguity when estimating similar actions, such as pouring juice and pouring coffee. To address this, we aim to exploit temporally global but spatially local human-object interactions (HOI) as video-level prior knowledge for action segmentation. The long-term HOI sequence provides crucial contextual information to distinguish ambiguous actions, where our network dynamically adapts to the given HOI sequence at test time. More specifically, we first design a video HOI encoder that extracts, selects, and integrates the most representative HOI throughout the video. Then, we propose a two-branch HyperNetwork to learn an adaptive temporal encoder, which automatically adjusts the parameters based on the HOI information of various videos on the fly. Extensive experiments on two widely-used datasets including Breakfast and 50Salads demonstrate the effectiveness of our method under different evaluation metrics.

AI.tldr: 提出一种名为AdaAct的HOI感知自适应网络，用于弱监督动作分割，通过利用全局时间但局部空间的人-物交互（HOI）作为视频级先验知识，动态适应不同视频的HOI信息，以解决相似动作识别模糊性问题。
AI.motivation: 现有方法使用固定网络预测帧级动作，导致相似动作（如倒果汁和倒咖啡）存在歧义，需要更好的区分机制。
AI.method: 设计视频HOI编码器提取、选择和整合最具代表性的HOI；提出双分支HyperNetwork学习自适应时间编码器，根据HOI信息动态调整参数。
AI.result: 在Breakfast和50Salads两个数据集上的实验表明，所提方法在多种评估指标下均有效。
AI.conclusion: 利用全局时间但局部空间的HOI序列作为先验知识，网络动态适应不同视频，能有效区分相似动作，提升弱监督动作分割性能。

title: EvoSelect: Data-Efficient LLM Evolution for Targeted Task Adaptation
summary: Adapting large language models (LLMs) to a targeted task efficiently and effectively remains a fundamental challenge. Such adaptation often requires iteratively improving the model toward a targeted task, yet collecting high-quality human-labeled data to support this process is costly and difficult to scale. As a result, synthetic data generation has emerged as a flexible and scalable alternative. One straightforward approach is through an iterative generation-training loop, where candidate data are synthesized through an external generator, the model is updated using these data and the process is repeated over iterations. However, generated samples can be noisy, highly redundant, or even misaligned with the targeted task distribution. Training indiscriminately on such data can dilute useful learning signals and even degrade model performance. To address this, we introduce a refined paradigm, namely an iterative generation-selection-training loop, which incorporates a selection step prior to model updates. Building on this paradigm, we propose EvoSelect, a data-efficient framework to evolve LLM effectively. Given candidate samples produced by the data generator, EvoSelect selects training data by jointly modeling targeted task alignment and diversity. We estimate task relevance through optimal transport with proxy gradient representations, which quantifies how well candidate samples align with the targeted task distribution. To mitigate redundancy, we incorporate a diversification mechanism that promotes coverage of complementary training samples. By interleaving alignment and diversification, EvoSelect enables progressive LLM evolution toward targeted tasks. Extensive experiments on various benchmarks demonstrate that with either weak or strong data generators, EvoSelect consistently improves adaptation efficacy over existing data selection methods.

AI.tldr: 提出EvoSelect框架，通过迭代式生成-选择-训练循环，结合最优传输和多样性机制，高效选择训练数据以进化LLM适配目标任务。
AI.motivation: 现有迭代式生成-训练循环中，合成数据存在噪声、冗余、与目标任务分布不匹配等问题，直接训练会稀释有效信号甚至降低模型性能。
AI.method: 提出EvoSelect框架，在生成-训练之间引入选择步骤：(1) 通过最优传输与代理梯度表示评估候选样本与目标任务的关联度；(2) 引入多样化机制促进互补样本覆盖；(3) 交替优化对齐性与多样性，实现渐进式LLM进化。
AI.result: 在多种基准测试中，无论使用弱生成器还是强生成器，EvoSelect均持续优于现有数据选择方法。
AI.conclusion: 迭代式生成-选择-训练循环是比直接生成-训练更有效的数据高效LLM适配范式，联合建模对齐性与多样性是关键。

title: FutureWorld: A Live Environment for Training Predictive Agents with Real-World Outcome Rewards
comment: Our experiments are ongoing, and we will release the code in the near future. We release a subset of our historical data on Hugging Face: https://huggingface.co/datasets/PredictingFuture/FutureWorld
summary: Live future prediction refers to the task of making predictions about real-world events before they unfold. This task is increasingly studied using large language model-based agent systems, and it is important for building agents that can continually learn from real-world. Just as interactive environments have often driven progress in agents, advancing live future prediction naturally motivates viewing it as a learning environment. Prior works have explored future prediction from several different parts, but have generally not framed it as a unified learning environment. This task is appealing for learning because it can provide a large number of prediction questions grounded in diverse real-world events, while preventing answer leakage. To leverage the advantages of live future prediction, we present FutureWorld, a live agentic reinforcement learning environment that closes the training loop between prediction, outcome realization, and parameters update. In our environment, we take three open-source base models and train them for consecutive days. The results show that training is effective. Furthermore, we build a daily benchmark based on the environment and evaluate several frontier agents on it to establish performance baselines for current agent systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FutureWorld——一个基于实时未来预测的智能体强化学习环境，通过预测-结果-参数更新的闭环训练，验证了持续训练对提升模型预测能力的有效性，并建立了当前前沿智能体的性能基准。
AI.motivation: 现有工作虽涉及未来预测的不同方面，但未将其统一为一个学习环境。实时未来预测能提供大量基于真实世界事件的预测问题，且能防止答案泄露，适合作为智能体的持续学习环境。
AI.method: 构建FutureWorld强化学习环境，在预测、结果实现、参数更新之间形成闭环训练；选取三个开源基础模型进行连续多天的训练。
AI.result: 持续训练对提升模型预测能力是有效的；基于该环境构建了每日基准测试，并评估了多个前沿智能体的表现。
AI.conclusion: FutureWorld是一个有效的实时未来预测学习环境，能够推动智能体从真实世界中持续学习。

title: Option-Order Randomisation Reveals a Distributional Position Attractor in Prompted Sandbagging
comment: 9 pages, 4 figures, 1 table. Pre-registered: https://osf.io/efr6s. Code and data: https://github.com/synthiumjp/bcb-sandbagging-pilot
summary: A predecessor pilot (Cacioli, 2026) found that Llama-3-8B implements prompted sandbagging as positional collapse rather than answer avoidance. However, fixed option ordering in MMLU-Pro left open whether this reflected a model-level position-dominant policy or dataset-level distractor structure. This pre-registered follow-up (3 models, 2,000 MMLU-Pro items, 4 conditions, 24,000 primary trials) added cyclic option-order randomisation as the critical control. The pre-registered item-level same-letter diagnostic did not confirm deterministic position-tracking (same-letter rate 37.3%, below the 50% threshold). However, pre-specified supporting analyses revealed that the response-position distribution under sandbagging was highly stable under complete content rotation (Pearson r = 0.9994; Jensen-Shannon divergence = 0.027, compared to 0.386 between honest and sandbagging conditions). Accuracy spiked to 72.1% when the correct answer coincidentally occupied the preferred position E, and fell to 4.3% at position A. The data provide strong evidence for a soft distributional attractor: under sandbagging instruction, the model enters a low-entropy response-position basin centred on E/F/G that is highly stable and largely content-invariant at the aggregate level. Qwen-2.5-7B served as a negative control (non-compliant, no distributional shift). These results provide evidence, at the 7-9 billion parameter scale, that response-position entropy is a promising black-box behavioural signature of this sandbagging mode.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过循环选项顺序随机化实验，发现大模型在提示式沙袋策略下会产生稳定的响应位置偏好（集中在E/F/G），而非真正的内容回避。这种位置驱动的软分布吸引子在7-9B参数级别上可作为沙袋行为的黑盒检测信号。
AI.motivation: 前期研究发现Llama-3-8B在沙袋策略下表现为位置坍缩而非答案回避，但固定选项顺序无法区分是模型级位置主导策略还是数据集级干扰结构导致的。本研究旨在通过循环选项顺序随机化这一关键控制实验，厘清沙袋行为的内在机制。
AI.method: 预注册的追踪实验：3个模型（含Qwen-2.5-7B作为阴性对照）、2,000个MMLU-Pro题目、4个条件、24,000次主实验。核心操作为循环选项顺序随机化，使用项目级相同字母诊断、响应位置分布稳定性分析（Pearson r、JS散度）等方法。
AI.result: 预注册的相同字母诊断未确认确定性位置跟踪（37.3%，低于50%阈值）。但支持性分析显示：沙袋条件下响应位置分布在完全内容旋转下高度稳定（r=0.9994, JS=0.027）；正确答案偶然落在偏好位置E时准确率达72.1%，位置A时仅4.3%。Qwen-2.5-7B无分布偏移。
AI.conclusion: 沙袋指令下模型进入一个以E/F/G为中心的低熵响应位置吸引子，该吸引子在聚合层面高度稳定且与内容无关。响应位置熵在7-9B参数规模上可作为沙袋模式的有前景的黑盒行为签名。

title: Breaking the Autoregressive Chain: Hyper-Parallel Decoding for Efficient LLM-Based Attribute Value Extraction
summary: Some text generation tasks, such as Attribute Value Extraction (AVE), require decoding multiple independent sequences from the same document context. While standard autoregressive decoding is slow due to its sequential nature, the independence between output sequences offers an opportunity for parallelism. We present Hyper-Parallel Decoding, a novel decoding algorithm that accelerates offline decoding by leveraging both shared memory and computation across batches. HPD enables out-of-order token generation through position ID manipulation, significantly improving efficiency. Experiments on AVE show that attribute-value pairs are conditionally independent, enabling us to parallelize value generation within each prompt. By further stacking multiple documents within a single prompt, we can decode in parallel up to 96 tokens per prompt. HPD works with all LLMs, and reduces both inference costs and total inference time by up to 13.8X without compromising output quality, potentially saving hundreds of thousands of dollars on industry AVE tasks. Although designed for attribute extraction, HPD makes no assumptions unique to the AVE domain and can in theory be applied to other scenarios with independent output structures.

AI.tldr: 提出超并行解码（HPD）算法，通过利用批处理中的共享内存和计算，实现属性值提取任务中多个独立序列的并行生成，在不影响输出质量前提下，推理成本和时间最高降低13.8倍。
AI.motivation: 标准自回归解码在属性值提取（AVE）等需要从同一文档上下文解码多个独立序列的任务中速度慢，而输出序列之间的独立性提供了并行化的机会。
AI.method: 提出超并行解码（Hyper-Parallel Decoding, HPD）算法，通过位置ID操作实现乱序token生成，利用批次间共享内存和计算，在单个提示中堆叠多个文档以实现最多96个token的并行解码。
AI.result: 在AVE任务上，推理成本和总推理时间最高降低13.8倍，且不牺牲输出质量，可为工业AVE任务节省数十万美元。
AI.conclusion: HPD适用于所有LLM，虽为属性提取设计但不依赖AVE领域特有假设，理论上可推广到其他具有独立输出结构的场景。

title: Camera-RFID Fusion for Robust Asset Tracking in Forested Environments
comment: 11 Pages, 10 Figures, Submitted and awaiting acceptance at IEEE RFID
summary: Passive RFID tags offer a cost-effective and scalable solution for tracking numerous deployed assets. However, in forested environments, signal attenuation and multipath effects generally limit RFID spatial accuracy to the meter level. Conversely, while cameras employing stereo vision can achieve centimeter-level precision, relying solely on computer vision fails to resolve issues arising from spatial association ambiguity and partial occlusions in dense settings. Fusing these modalities allows systems to harness the high-accuracy benefits of vision while retaining the robust, non-line-of-sight identification advantages of RFID. Yet, a primary challenge in achieving this, which is the central focus of this paper, lies in accurately associating the disparate trajectories generated by these two sensors. To overcome this limitation, we introduce a novel camera--RFID fusion framework that integrates depth and object information with advanced trajectory-matching algorithms. By successfully bridging the meter-to-centimeter accuracy gap, the proposed approach helps achieve reliable tag localization even when assets temporarily leave the camera's field of view. To the best of our knowledge, this represents the first application of camera--RFID fusion for asset tracking in natural forested environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种相机-RFID融合框架，通过结合深度信息、物体信息和轨迹匹配算法，解决了森林环境中无源RFID标签定位精度低（米级）与相机视觉精度高（厘米级）但受遮挡和关联模糊影响的问题，首次实现了自然森林环境中的高精度资产跟踪。
AI.motivation: 无源RFID在森林环境中受信号衰减和多径效应影响，定位精度仅为米级；而相机视觉虽可达厘米级精度，但在密集场景中存在空间关联模糊和部分遮挡问题。融合两种模态可兼顾高精度与非视距识别优势，但如何准确关联两种传感器产生的不同轨迹是核心挑战。
AI.method: 提出了一种相机-RFID融合框架，该框架集成了深度信息、物体信息以及先进的轨迹匹配算法，用于关联两种传感器的轨迹数据。
AI.result: 成功弥合了米级到厘米级的精度差距，即使资产暂时离开相机视野，也能实现可靠的标签定位。
AI.conclusion: 这是相机-RFID融合首次应用于自然森林环境中的资产跟踪，验证了该方法在复杂户外场景下的有效性和鲁棒性。

title: Comparative Analysis of AutoML and BiLSTM Models for Cyberbullying Detection on Indonesian Instagram Comments
comment: 7 pages, 5 tables, 2 figures. The manuscript presents a comparative study of machine learning and deep learning methods for Indonesian cyberbullying detection on Instagram comments
summary: This study compares machine learning and deep learning approaches for cyberbullying detection in Indonesian-language Instagram comments. Using a balanced dataset of 650 comments labeled as Bullying and Non-Bullying, the study evaluates Naive Bayes, Logistic Regression, and Support Vector Machine with TF-IDF features, as well as BiLSTM and BiLSTM with Bahdanau Attention. A preprocessing pipeline tailored to informal Indonesian text is applied, including slang normalization, stopword removal, and stemming. The results show that Logistic Regression performs best among the machine learning models, while BiLSTM with Attention achieves the strongest overall deep learning performance. The findings highlight the value of domain-specific preprocessing and show that although deep learning captures contextual patterns more effectively, machine learning remains a competitive option for resource-constrained deployments.

AI.tldr: 比较了机器学习与深度学习方法在印尼语Instagram评论中进行网络欺凌检测的效果，发现Logistic Regression在机器学习中表现最佳，而带注意力机制的BiLSTM在深度学习中表现最优。
AI.motivation: 社交媒体上的网络欺凌问题日益严重，印尼语作为一种非英语语言，缺乏针对性检测研究。本研究旨在探索适用于印尼语非正式文本的网络欺凌检测方法。
AI.method: 使用650条平衡标注数据集（欺凌/非欺凌），对Naive Bayes、Logistic Regression、SVM（TF-IDF特征）以及BiLSTM、BiLSTM+Bahdanau Attention进行对比。采用针对印尼语非正式文本的预处理流程，包括俚语规范化、停用词移除和词干提取。
