AI.result: 机器学习中Logistic Regression表现最佳；深度学习中BiLSTM+Attention取得最强整体性能。深度学习在上下文模式捕捉上更有效，但机器学习在资源受限场景下仍具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 领域特定的预处理对印尼语网络欺凌检测有重要价值，深度学习虽能更好捕捉上下文模式，但机器学习在部署资源有限时仍是可行选择。

title: MetaSR: Content-Adaptive Metadata Orchestration for Generative Super-Resolution
summary: We study generative super-resolution (SR) in real-world scenarios where content and degradations vary across domains, genres, and segments. For example, images and videos may alternate between text overlays, fast motion, smooth cartoons, and low-light faces, each benefiting from different forms of side information. Existing metadata-guided SR methods typically use a fixed conditioning design, which is suboptimal when useful cues are content dependent and transmission budgets are limited. We propose MetaSR, a Diffusion Transformer (DiT)-based framework that selects and injects task-relevant metadata to guide SR under resource constraints. Specifically, we use the DiT's own VAE and transformer backbone to fuse heterogeneous metadata, and adopt an efficient distillation strategy that enables one-step diffusion inference. Experiments across diverse content buckets and degradation regimes show that MetaSR outperforms reference solutions by up to 1.0~dB PSNR while achieving up to 50\% transmission bitrate saving at matched quality. We assess these gains under a rate--distortion optimization (RDO) framework that jointly accounts for sender-side bitrate and receiver/display quality metrics (e.g., PSNR and SSIM).

AI.tldr: 提出了MetaSR，一种基于扩散变换器（DiT）的框架，能够根据内容选择并注入任务相关的元数据来指导超分辨率，在资源受限条件下实现高达1.0 dB的PSNR提升和50%的传输码率节省。
AI.motivation: 现有元数据引导的超分辨率方法采用固定条件设计，在不同内容域（如文本、运动、卡通、低光人脸等）下效果不佳，且传输带宽有限，需要一种能根据内容自适应选择有用元数据的方法。
AI.method: 提出MetaSR，基于Diffusion Transformer (DiT)框架，利用DiT自身的VAE和Transformer骨干网络融合异构元数据，并采用高效的蒸馏策略实现一步扩散推理。
AI.result: 在多种内容类型和退化条件下，MetaSR相比参考方案PSNR提升高达1.0 dB，在相同质量下可节省高达50%的传输码率。
AI.conclusion: MetaSR通过内容自适应的元数据选择和注入，在率失真优化框架下有效平衡了发送端码率和接收端显示质量，实现了更优的超分辨率性能。

title: A New Semisupervised Technique for Polarity Analysis using Masked Language Models
summary: I developed a new version of Latent Semantic Scaling (LSS) employing word2vec as a masked language model. Unlike original spatial models, it assigns polarity scores to words and documents as predicted probabilities of seed words to occur in given contexts. These probabilistic polarity scores are more accurate, interpretable and consistent than those spatial polarity models can produce in text analysis. I demonstrate these advantages by applying both probabilistic and spatial models to China Daily's coverage of China and other countries during the coronavirus disease (COVID) pandemic in terms of achievement in health issues. The result suggests that more advanced masked language models would further improve the semisupervised machine learning technique.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于word2vec掩码语言模型的概率型潜在语义缩放（LSS）新方法，相比传统空间模型，能生成更准确、可解释且一致的极性分数，并通过COVID-19期间《中国日报》的报道分析验证了其优势。
AI.motivation: 传统空间极性模型在文本分析中准确性、可解释性和一致性不足，需要更优的语义缩放方法。
AI.method: 使用word2vec作为掩码语言模型，将词和文档的极性分数建模为种子词在给定上下文中出现的预测概率，而非空间距离。
AI.result: 概率型极性分数比空间模型更准确、可解释且一致；在《中国日报》COVID-19报道分析中验证了效果。
AI.conclusion: 更先进的掩码语言模型有望进一步提升这种半监督机器学习技术的性能。

title: Beyond Shortcuts: Mitigating Visual Illusions in Frozen VLMs via Qualitative Reasoning
comment: 4 pages, 2 figures, and 1 table. This is a methodology paper for the DataCV 2026 Challenge (CVPR Workshops), Task 1, where our method ranked 2nd
summary: While Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have achieved state-of-the-art performance in general visual tasks, their perceptual robustness remains remarkably brittle when confronted with optical illusions. These failures are often attributed to shortcut heuristics, where models prioritize linguistic priors and memorized prototypes over direct visual evidence. In this work, we propose Structured Qualitative Inference (SQI), a training-free, data-centric framework designed to fortify visual grounding in frozen VLMs. SQI addresses perceptual anomalies through three systematic modules: (1) Axiomatic Constraint Injection, which suppresses erroneous metric estimations and quantitative hallucinations; (2) Hierarchical Scene Decomposition, which decouples target visual manifolds from complex background distractors; and (3) Counterfactual Self-Verification, an adversarial reasoning step that mitigates confirmation bias. By orchestrating these qualitative constraints at inference time, SQI effectively aligns high-level linguistic reasoning with low-level visual perception. Our framework was evaluated on the DataCV 2026 Challenge (Task I: Classic Illusion Understanding), where it ranked 2nd place overall. Experimental results demonstrate that SQI not only significantly enhances accuracy across diverse illusion categories but also provides superior diagnostic interpretability without any model fine-tuning. Our success underscores the potential of structured qualitative grounding as a robust paradigm for developing next-generation, illusion-resistant vision-language systems.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种无需训练的定性推理框架SQI，通过公理约束注入、层次化场景分解和反事实自我验证三个模块，增强冻结视觉语言模型在光学错觉下的感知鲁棒性，在DataCV 2026挑战赛中获得第二名。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型在处理光学错觉时表现出感知脆弱性，模型倾向于依赖语言先验和记忆原型而非直接视觉证据，缺乏对感知异常的鲁棒处理能力。
AI.method: SQI框架包含三个模块：1) 公理约束注入——抑制错误度量估计和量化幻觉；2) 层次化场景分解——从复杂背景干扰中分离目标视觉流形；3) 反事实自我验证——通过对抗性推理缓解确认偏差。这些模块在推理阶段协同工作，无需模型微调。
AI.result: 在DataCV 2026挑战赛（经典错觉理解任务）中排名第二，显著提升了多种错觉类别上的准确率，并提供了优越的诊断可解释性。
AI.conclusion: 结构化定性推理是构建鲁棒、抗错觉的视觉语言系统的有效范式，无需额外训练即可增强模型的视觉基础能力。

title: StratMem-Bench: Evaluating Strategic Memory Use in Virtual Character Conversation Beyond Factual Recall
summary: Achieving realistic human-like conversation for virtual characters requires not only a simple memorization and recall of past events, but also the strategic utilization of memory to meet factual needs and social engagement. Current memory utilization relevant (e.g., memory-augmented generation, long-term dialogue, and etc.) benchmarks overlook this nuance, treating memory primarily as a static repository of facts rather than a dynamic resource to be strategically deployed in dialogues. To address this gap, we design StratMem-Bench, a new benchmark to evaluate strategic memory use in character-centric dialogues. This dataset comprises 657 instances where virtual characters must navigate heterogeneous memory pools containing required, supportive, and irrelevant memories. We also propose a framework with different evaluation metrics including Strict Memory Compliance, Memory Integration Quality, Proactive Enrichment Score and Conditional Irrelevance Rate, to evaluate strategic memory use capabilities of virtual characters. Experiments on StratMem-Bench which leverage the state-of-the-art large language models as virtual characters show that all models perform well at distinguishing between required and irrelevant memories, but struggle once supportive memories are introduced into the decision process.

AI.tldr: 现有记忆基准将记忆视为静态事实库，忽略了对话中记忆的战略性运用。本文提出StratMem-Bench基准（657个实例），要求虚拟角色在包含必要、支持和无关记忆的异构池中导航，并设计四项评估指标。实验表明，现有大模型能区分必要与无关记忆，但在引入支持性记忆时表现不佳。
AI.motivation: 当前记忆增强生成、长程对话等基准将记忆简单视为静态事实库，忽略了虚拟角色在对话中需要战略性运用记忆来满足事实需求和社会参与这一关键能力，存在评估空白。
AI.method: 构建StratMem-Bench基准数据集（657个实例），包含需要虚拟角色在必要、支持和无关记忆组成的异构记忆池中进行导航的对话场景；提出四项评估指标：严格记忆合规性、记忆整合质量、主动丰富得分和条件不相关率；使用最先进大语言模型作为虚拟角色进行实验。
AI.result: 所有大模型在区分必要记忆和无关记忆方面表现良好，但在引入支持性记忆后，决策过程出现困难，性能明显下降。
AI.conclusion: 现有大模型在战略性记忆运用上存在明显不足，特别是面对支持性记忆时决策能力薄弱，StratMem-Bench为评估和提升虚拟角色的对话记忆策略提供了有效工具。

title: Multi-Stage Bi-Atrial Segmentation Framework from 3D Late Gadolinium-Enhanced MRI using V-Net Family Models
comment: 6 pages, 2 figures, technical report for participating the MBAS2024 challenge hosted on the MICCAI2024 conference
summary: We report our multi-stage framework designed for the problem of multi-class bi-atrial segmentation from 3D late gadolinium-enhanced (LGE) MRI of the human heart. The pipeline consists of a preprocessing step using multidimensional contrast limited adaptive histogram equalization (MCLAHE); coarse region segmentation from MCLAHE-enhanced and down-sampled MRI using a V-Net family model; and fine segmentation from the coarse region using another V-Net model. Asymmetric loss is adopted to optimize the model weights.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个多阶段框架，用于从3D LGE MRI中实现人类心脏的双心房多类分割，包含MCLAHE预处理、粗分割（V-Net）和精细分割（V-Net）步骤，并采用非对称损失优化模型权重。
AI.motivation: 为了解决从3D LGE MRI中准确分割双心房（多类）的挑战，提升分割精度和鲁棒性。
AI.method: 采用多阶段流水线：1) MCLAHE预处理增强图像；2) 在降采样后的增强MRI上用V-Net进行粗区域分割；3) 在粗分割区域内用另一个V-Net进行精细分割；使用非对称损失函数优化模型权重。
AI.result: 未在摘要中明确给出具体的量化结果，但框架设计旨在提升多类双心房分割的性能。
AI.conclusion: 该多阶段框架结合MCLAHE增强、粗到精分割策略和非对称损失，为3D LGE MRI双心房分割提供了一种有效的解决方案。

title: FlowBot: Inducing LLM Workflows with Bilevel Optimization and Textual Gradients
summary: LLM workflows, which coordinate structured calls to individual LLMs (each augmented with varying instructions and tools) to achieve a particular goal, offer a promising path towards extending the capabilities of LLMs and building powerful systems that can tackle diverse tasks. However, existing approaches for building such workflows generally rely on human-crafted pipelines and prompts, which presents a substantial bottleneck in real world deployment. How can automatically induce and optimize such workflows in a data-driven way? This paper describes a simple data-driven approach for automatically inducing LLM workflows. We formulate workflow induction as a bilevel optimization problem: an outer loop which optimizes a high-level sketch of the workflow (in particular how the LLM calls should be structured), and an inner loop which optimizes each individual LLM call one-by one. Both loops are optimized with ``textual gradients'' where for the inner loop we optimize each component in a modular way through ``backpropagating'' textual gradients layer-by-layer. We find that LLM workflows discovered through our \textsc{FlowBot} (work\textbf{flow} induction through \textbf{b}ilevel \textbf{o}ptimization and \textbf{t}extual gradients) approach performs competitively against strong baselines that make use of human-crafted or automatically-generated workflows.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FlowBot，一种通过双层优化和文本梯度自动发现LLM工作流的数驱动方法，无需人工设计流水线和提示词。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM工作流构建依赖人工设计的流水线和提示词，成为实际部署中的瓶颈，需要一种自动化的数据驱动方法来发现和优化工作流。
AI.method: 将工作流归纳建模为双层优化问题：外层优化工作流的高层草图（LLM调用结构），内层逐一优化每个LLM调用。通过"文本梯度"机制实现逐层反向传播式的模块化优化。
AI.result: FlowBot发现的工作流在性能上与人工构建或自动生成的强基线方法具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 数据驱动的自动化工作流归纳是一种可行的替代方案，能够减少人工瓶颈，同时达到与人工设计相媲美的效果。

title: OmniTrend: Content-Context Modeling for Scalable Social Popularity Prediction
summary: Predicting social media popularity requires understanding both the intrinsic appeal of content and the external context that determines how it is exposed to users. Existing methods focus on content signals but do not separate them from exposure-related patterns, which causes the learned representations to absorb platform-specific visibility effects and weakens both interpretability and cross-platform transfer. This paper introduces OmniTrend, a unified framework that models popularity as the joint outcome of content attractiveness and contextual exposure. The content module learns cross-modal representations from visual, audio, and textual cues to quantify intrinsic appeal, while the context module estimates exposure from exogenous signals such as posting time, author activity, topical trends, and retrieval-based neighborhood statistics. OmniTrend learns separate predictors for content attractiveness and contextual exposure and integrates them in the final popularity estimate, which makes the role of each factor explicit and supports robust transfer across image and video platforms.

AI.tldr: OmniTrend是一个统一框架，将社交媒体流行度分解为内容吸引力（多模态特征）和情境曝光（时间、作者、主题等外生信号），分别建模后整合预测，提升了可解释性和跨平台迁移能力。
AI.motivation: 现有方法将内容信号与曝光相关模式混在一起学习，导致模型吸收了平台特定的可见性效应，削弱了可解释性和跨平台迁移能力。
AI.method: 提出OmniTrend框架，包含两个模块：内容模块从视觉、音频、文本中学习跨模态表示以量化内在吸引力；情境模块从发布时间、作者活跃度、主题趋势和检索邻域统计等外生信号估计曝光。分别学习两个预测器，最后整合为最终流行度估计。
AI.result: 框架能显式区分内容吸引力与情境曝光各自的作用，支持在图像和视频平台间的鲁棒迁移。
AI.conclusion: 将流行度分解为内容吸引力与情境曝光两个可解释因素，能够提升模型的透明度和跨平台泛化能力。

title: Calibrated Surprise: An Information-Theoretic Account of Creative Quality
summary:
The essence of good creative writing is calibrated surprise: when constraints from all relevant dimensions act together, the feasible solution space collapses into a narrow region, and the surviving choices look least predictable from an unconstrained view. "Calibrated" has a precise meaning: the author's intent, the reader's reasonable expectation, and the logic of reality converge. When these three independent judgements agree on every dimension, the set of admissible writing choices is forced into a very small region. A mathematical corollary follows: full-dimensional accuracy and mediocrity are mutually exclusive -- two sides of one constraint structure, not separate goals.
  We use Shannon's mutual information $I(X;Y) = H(X) - H(X|Y)$ as our analysis tool. "Calibrated" corresponds to conditional entropy going to zero; "surprise" to entropy going up; mutual information is the precise measure of the joint quantity. The argument rests on two pillars. Static: when constraints from ethos, mythos, lexis, and dianoia are imposed together, the admissible set collapses sharply, and surviving solutions show up as low-probability choices from an unconstrained view. Dynamic: the chain rule shows each writing choice is constrained by what came before and constrains what comes after; macro-level decisions naturally contribute a larger share of information, removing the need for hand-tuned weighting.
  Through case studies and lightweight LLM-logprob computations, we show the framework is both analytically useful and operational, laying the theoretical groundwork for Creative Quality Alignment (CQA) and a professional evaluation benchmark.

AI.tldr: 本文提出创意写作的本质是"校准的惊喜"（calibrated surprise），即作者意图、读者预期和现实逻辑三个维度约束下，可行解空间坍缩至极小区域，使得最终选择在无约束视角下显得最不可预测。使用香农互信息作为分析工具，证明"校准"对应条件熵趋零，"惊喜"对应熵值上升。通过静态（多维度约束联合作用）和动态（链式法则约束前后文）两大支柱论证，并结合案例与LLM logprob计算验证框架的实用性和可操作性，为创意质量对齐（CQA）和专业评估基准奠定理论基础。
AI.motivation: 现有写作评价缺乏精确量化框架，难以同时衡量"惊喜感"与"合理性"这一对看似矛盾的目标。作者希望用信息论为创意写作建立严格的数学基础，解决"好作品既出人意料又合情合理"这一直觉的精确化问题。
AI.method: 采用香农互信息 I(X;Y)=H(X)-H(X|Y) 作为核心分析工具，构建静态和动态两个分析支柱。静态分析将约束维度（ethos、mythos、lexis、dianoia）联合作用下的解空间坍缩过程建模；动态分析利用链式法则刻画写作选择的前后约束关系。辅以案例研究和轻量级LLM logprob计算进行实证验证。
AI.result: 理论推导表明：全维度准确性与平庸性并非两个独立目标，而是一个约束结构的两面——当所有约束维度达成一致时，可行解空间急剧缩小，幸存解在无约束视角下恰好呈现为低概率（即高惊喜）选择。LLM logprob计算支持了这一理论框架的可操作性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为创意质量对齐（Creative Quality Alignment, CQA）提供了理论基础，可用于构建专业写作评估基准，兼顾了理论严谨性与实际可操作性。

title: GaitKD: A Universal Decoupled Distillation Framework for Efficient Gait Recognition
summary: Gait recognition is an attractive biometric modality for long-range and contact-free identification, but high-performing gait models often rely on deep and computationally expensive architectures that are difficult to deploy in practice. Knowledge distillation (KD) offers a natural way to transfer knowledge from a powerful teacher to an efficient student; however, standard KD is often less effective for part-structured gait models, where supervision is formed from both part-wise classification logits and part-wise retrieval embeddings. In this paper, we propose GaitKD, a distillation framework that decouples gait knowledge transfer into two complementary components: decision-level distillation and boundary-level distillation. Specifically, GaitKD aligns the teacher and student through part-calibrated logit distillation to transfer inter-class decision relations, while preserving the teacher-induced partitioning of the embedding space through an activation-boundary objective instead of direct feature regression. With a simple aligned part-wise design, GaitKD supports heterogeneous teacher-student gait models without introducing additional inference cost. Experimental results across multiple gait recognition benchmarks and teacher-student configurations show consistent improvements over strong gait baselines. Our study demonstrates that the two transfer components are complementary, and boundary-preserving distillation provides more stable performance than direct feature regression. Source code is available at https://github.com/liyiersan/GaitKD/

AI.tldr: 提出GaitKD框架，将步态知识蒸馏解耦为决策级蒸馏和边界级蒸馏，实现高效步态识别模型的轻量化部署。
AI.motivation: 高性能步态模型通常依赖深度且计算昂贵的架构，难以实际部署；标准知识蒸馏对基于部件的步态模型效果不佳，因为其监督同时来自部件级分类logits和部件级检索嵌入。
AI.method: 提出GaitKD框架，包含两个互补组件：1）决策级蒸馏：通过部件校准的logit蒸馏传递类间决策关系；2）边界级蒸馏：通过激活边界目标保留教师诱导的嵌入空间划分，而非直接特征回归。采用简单的对齐部件设计，支持异构师生步态模型。
AI.result: 在多个步态识别基准和师生配置下，相比强基线方法取得一致的性能提升。实验表明两个蒸馏组件互补，边界保持蒸馏比直接特征回归更稳定。
AI.conclusion: GaitKD通过解耦决策级和边界级蒸馏，有效提升了步态知识蒸馏性能，且不引入额外推理成本。

title: Folding Tensor and Sequence Parallelism for Memory-Efficient Transformer Training & Inference
summary: We present tensor and sequence parallelism (TSP), a parallel execution strategy that folds tensor parallelism and sequence parallelism onto a single device axis. In conventional multi-dimensional parallelism layouts, tensor parallelism (TP) shards model weights while sequence parallelism (SP) shards tokens, reducing per-device parameter or activation memory, respectively. Traditionally, each scheme is assigned its own mesh dimension. TSP instead assigns each rank both a weight shard and a sequence shard, reducing both parameter and activation memory along the same device axis. We implement this design with two runtime schedules. For attention, ranks iterate over broadcast parameter shards and reconstruct context through a sequence-wise key/value exchange. For gated MLPs, weight shards circulate in a ring while partial outputs accumulate locally. By sharding both weights and activations across the same devices, TSP trades additional communication volume for reduced memory overhead. We provide a theoretical communication and memory analysis, describe our implementation of TSP attention and gated MLP blocks, and benchmark TSP against TP, SP, and TP+SP. These results position TSP as a hardware-aware alternative for long-context and memory-constrained model training, and as a viable axis of parallelism in concert with existing parallelism schemes such as pipeline and expert parallelism for dense and mixture-of-expert models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出张量和序列并行（TSP），将张量并行和序列并行折叠到单一设备轴，通过同时分片权重和序列来减少内存开销，并设计了两种运行时调度方案（注意力层的广播式KV交换和门控MLP的环形权重循环），在增加通信量的代价下降低内存需求，适用于长上下文和内存受限的模型训练。
AI.motivation: 传统多维并行策略中，张量并行和序列并行分别在不同设备轴上进行，导致内存优化不够灵活。TSP旨在通过将两者合并到同一设备轴，同时减少参数和激活内存，为长上下文和内存受限场景提供更高效的并行方案。
AI.method: TSP将每个设备同时分配权重分片和序列分片，沿同一设备轴分片权重和激活。注意力层采用广播参数分片并通过序列级KV交换重建上下文；门控MLP层使用环形权重循环，局部累积部分输出。
AI.result: 通过理论通信和内存分析，以及对比TP、SP和TP+SP的基准测试，验证了TSP在内存节省方面的优势，尽管增加了通信量。
AI.conclusion: TSP可作为硬件感知的并行替代方案，适用于长上下文和内存受限训练，并能与流水线并行、专家并行等现有方案协同工作，适用于密集模型和混合专家模型。

title: Multiple Consistent 2D-3D Mappings for Robust Zero-Shot 3D Visual Grounding
summary:
Zero-shot 3D Visual Grounding (3DVG) is a critical capability for open-world embodied AI. However, existing methods are fundamentally bottlenecked by the poor quality of open-vocabulary 3D proposals, suffering from inaccurate categories and imprecise geometries, as well as the spatial redundancy of exhaustive multi-view reasoning. To address these challenges, we propose MCM-VG, a novel framework that achieves robust zero-shot 3DVG by explicitly establishing Multiple Consistent 2D-3D Mappings. Instead of passively relying on noisy 3D segments, MCM-VG enforces 2D-3D consistency across three fundamental dimensions to achieve precise target localization and reliable reasoning. First, a Semantic Alignment module corrects category mismatches via LLM-driven query parsing and coarse-to-fine 2D-3D matching. Second, an Instance Rectification module leverages VLM-guided 2D segmentations to reconstruct missing targets, back-projecting these reliable visual priors to establish accurate 3D geometries. Finally, to eliminate spatial redundancy, a Viewpoint Distillation module clusters 3D camera directions to extract optimal frames. By pairing these optimal RGB frames with Bird's Eye View maps into concise visual prompt sets, we formulate the final target disambiguation as a multiple-choice reasoning task for Vision-Language Models.
  Extensive evaluations on ScanRefer and Nr3D benchmarks demonstrate that MCM-VG sets a new state-of-the-art for zero-shot 3D visual grounding. Remarkably, it achieves 62.0\% and 53.6\% in Acc@0.25 and Acc@0.5 on ScanRefer, outperforming previous baselines by substantial margins of 6.4\% and 4.0\%.

AI.tldr: 提出MCM-VG框架，通过建立多视角一致的2D-3D映射，结合语义对齐、实例修正和视角精炼三个模块，解决零样本3D视觉定位中3D提案质量差和空间冗余问题，在ScanRefer和Nr3D基准上达到新SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有零样本3D视觉定位方法受限于开放词汇3D提案质量差（类别不准、几何不精确）以及多视角推理的空间冗余问题。
AI.method: 提出MCM-VG框架，包含三个模块：(1) 语义对齐模块：通过LLM驱动的查询解析和粗到细的2D-3D匹配纠正类别错配；(2) 实例修正模块：利用VLM引导的2D分割重建缺失目标，反投影建立精确3D几何；(3) 视角精炼模块：聚类3D相机方向提取最优帧，结合BEV图构建视觉提示集，将目标消歧建模为多选推理任务。
AI.result: 在ScanRefer上Acc@0.25达62.0%，Acc@0.5达53.6%，分别超越此前最优方法6.4%和4.0%，在Nr3D上也达到新SOTA。
AI.conclusion: MCM-VG通过显式建立多视角一致的2D-3D映射，有效解决了零样本3DVG的核心瓶颈，为开放世界具身AI提供了可靠的定位能力。

title: Benchmarking PyCaret AutoML Against BiLSTM for Fine-Grained Emotion Classification: A Comparative Study on 20-Class Emotion Detection
comment: 7 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. This paper compares machine learning and deep learning methods for 20-class emotion classification on an English text dataset of 79,595 samples
summary: Fine-grained emotion classification, which identifies specific emotional states such as happiness, anger, sadness, and fear, remains a challenging task in natural language processing. This study benchmarks classical machine learning and deep learning approaches for 20-class emotion classification using the 20-Emotion Text Classification Dataset containing 79,595 English sentences. On the machine learning side, Logistic Regression, Multinomial Naive Bayes, and Support Vector Machine are evaluated using TF-IDF features. On the deep learning side, Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory, Gated Recurrent Unit, and a lightweight Transformer implemented in PyTorch are compared. The results show that BiLSTM achieves the best overall performance with 89% accuracy and a weighted F1-score of 0.89, slightly outperforming the best machine learning model, SVM, which reaches 88.11% accuracy. The findings indicate that while traditional machine learning models remain competitive and computationally efficient, sequence-based deep learning models better capture contextual emotional cues in text.

AI.tldr: 本研究对20类细粒度情感分类任务进行了基准测试，比较了传统机器学习（逻辑回归、朴素贝叶斯、SVM）和深度学习（BiLSTM、GRU、轻量Transformer）方法，结果显示BiLSTM以89%准确率和0.89 F1-score最优，略胜SVM的88.11%。
AI.motivation: 细粒度情感分类在NLP中仍是挑战性任务，现有研究缺乏对多类别（20类）情感分类系统性的方法对比，需要评估不同模型在该任务上的表现与效率。
AI.method: 使用20-Emotion Text Classification Dataset（79,595条英文句子），对比三种机器学习模型（LR、MNB、SVM+TF-IDF）和三种深度学习模型（BiLSTM、GRU、轻量Transformer），以准确率和加权F1-score为评估指标。
AI.result: BiLSTM取得最优性能（准确率89%，F1=0.89），SVM次之（准确率88.11%），深度学习模型整体优于传统机器学习模型，但传统模型仍具竞争力且计算效率更高。
AI.conclusion: 序列深度学习模型能更好地捕捉文本中的上下文情感线索；传统机器学习模型在资源受限场景下仍是高效可行的选择。

title: Semantic Foam: Unifying Spatial and Semantic Scene Decomposition
comment: 15 pages, 10 figures, Accepted to CVPR 2026 (Highlight) , Project page: http://semanticfoam.github.io/
summary: Modern scene reconstruction methods, such as 3D Gaussian Splatting, enable photo-realistic novel view synthesis at real-time speeds. However, their adoption in interactive graphics applications remains limited due to the difficulty of interacting with these representations compared to traditional, human-authored 3D assets. While prior work has attempted to impose semantic decomposition on these models, significant challenges remain in segmentation quality and cross-view consistency.To address these limitations, we introduce Semantic Foam, which extends the recently proposed Radiant Foam representation to semantic decomposition tasks. Our approach leverages the inherent spatial structure of Radiant Foam's volumetric Voronoi mesh and augments it with an explicit semantic feature field defined at the cell level. This design enables direct spatial regularization, improving consistency across views and mitigating artifacts caused by occlusion and inconsistent supervision, which are common issues in point-based representations.Experimental results demonstrate that our method achieves superior object-level segmentation performance compared to state-of-the-art approaches such as Gaussian Grouping and SAGA.Project page: http://semanticfoam.github.io/

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Semantic Foam，在 Radiant Foam 的体素 Voronoi 网格基础上引入语义特征场，实现了比现有方法更优的跨视图一致性物体级分割。
AI.motivation: 现有场景重建方法（如 3D 高斯泼溅）虽能实时生成逼真的新视角图像，但与传统的、人工制作的 3D 资产相比，用户难以与之交互；先前的语义分解工作在分割质量和跨视图一致性方面仍存在显著不足。
AI.method: 利用 Radiant Foam 的体素 Voronoi 网格的空间结构，在细胞级别上定义显式的语义特征场，从而直接在空间上对语义进行正则化，提升跨视图一致性并减轻遮挡和不一致监督带来的伪影。
AI.result: 在物体级分割任务上，该方法在性能上优于 Gaussian Grouping 和 SAGA 等最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: Semantic Foam 通过将语义特征场与 Voronoi 网格结构结合，有效提升了语义分解的跨视图一致性，为交互式图形应用中的场景重建提供了更好的可交互性。

title: Classification of Public Opinion on the Free Nutritional Meal Program on YouTube Media Using the LSTM Method
comment: 10 pages 3 figures 3 tables Conference submission on YouTube sentiment classification using LSTM for the Free Nutritious Meal Program
summary: Public opinion towards the Free Nutritious Meal Program (MBG) on YouTube social media reflects diverse community responses. This study applies the Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) method to classify sentiments from 7,733 YouTube comments. The results show that the LSTM model achieves 89% accuracy, with strong performance on negative sentiment (F1-score 0.94) but weaker performance on positive sentiment (F1-score 0.55) due to class imbalance, as negative data account for 87.7% of the dataset. These findings confirm the effectiveness of LSTM for sentiment analysis of Indonesian text while highlighting the challenge of imbalanced data. This research contributes to social media-based public policy evaluation

AI.tldr: 使用LSTM对YouTube上关于免费营养餐计划（MBG）的7737条印尼语评论进行情感分析，模型准确率89%，但对正面情感识别较弱（F1分数0.55），主要由于数据不平衡（负面评论占87.7%）。
AI.motivation: YouTube上公众对免费营养餐计划（MBG）的舆论反映了多元的社区反应，需要系统化的情感分析来评估公众意见。
AI.method: 采用长短期记忆网络（LSTM）方法，对7737条YouTube评论进行情感分类。
AI.result: LSTM模型准确率达89%，负面情感F1分数0.94（表现优秀），正面情感F1分数0.55（表现较弱），原因是负面数据占数据集87.7%的不平衡问题。
AI.conclusion: LSTM对印尼文本的情感分析有效，但数据不平衡仍是挑战；该研究有助于基于社交媒体的公共政策评估。

title: High-Dimensional Noise to Low-Dimensional Manifolds: A Manifold-Space Diffusion Framework for Degraded Hyperspectral Image Classification
summary: Recently, Hyperspectral Image (HSI) classification has attracted increasing attention in remote sensing. However, HSI data are inherently high-dimensional but low-rank, with discriminative information concentrated on a low-dimensional latent manifold. In real-world remote sensing scenarios, the superposition of multiple degradation factors disrupts this intrinsic manifold structure, driving samples away from their original low-dimensional distribution and introducing substantial redundant and non-discriminative variations. To better handle this challenge, this paper proposes a manifold-space diffusion framework (MSDiff) for robust hyperspectral classification under complex degradation conditions. Specifically, the proposed method first maps high-dimensional, degradation-affected HSI data into a compact low-dimensional manifold through a discriminative spectral-spatial reconstruction task, preserving class semantics and reducing redundant variations. A diffusion-based generative model is then applied to regularize the spectral-spatial distribution within the manifold, enabling progressive refinement and stabilization of latent features against residual degradations. The key advantage of the proposed framework lies in performing diffusion-based distribution modeling directly on the low-dimensional manifold, effectively decoupling degradation-induced disturbances from intrinsic discriminative structures and enhancing representation stability under complex degradations. Experimental results on multiple hyperspectral benchmarks demonstrate consistent performance improvements over state-of-the-art methods under diverse composite degradation settings. The code will be available at https://github.com/yangboxiang1207/MSDiff

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种流形空间扩散框架（MSDiff），通过将高光谱图像映射到低维流形后进行扩散模型正则化，实现复杂退化条件下的鲁棒分类。
AI.motivation: 高光谱图像具有高维低秩特性，真实场景中多种退化因素叠加会破坏其内在流形结构，导致冗余和非判别性变异增加，现有方法难以应对这一挑战。
AI.method: 首先通过判别性光谱-空间重构任务将退化HSI数据映射到紧凑低维流形，保留类别语义并减少冗余变异；然后在流形上应用扩散生成模型正则化光谱-空间分布，逐步精炼和稳定潜在特征以抵抗残余退化。
AI.result: 在多个高光谱基准数据集上，该方法在多种复杂复合退化设置下均实现了优于现有最先进方法的一致性性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 在低维流形上直接进行扩散分布建模，能有效解耦退化诱导的干扰与内在判别结构，增强复杂退化下的表示稳定性，为鲁棒高光谱分类提供了新范式。

title: A Systematic Comparison of Prompting and Multi-Agent Methods for LLM-based Stance Detection
summary: Stance detection identifies the attitude of a text author toward a given target. Recent studies have explored various LLM-based strategies for this task, from zero-shot prompting to multi-agent debate. However, existing works differ in data splits, base models, and evaluation protocols, making fair comparison difficult. We conduct a systematic comparison that evaluates five methods across two categories -- prompt-based inference (Direct Prompting, Auto-CoT, StSQA) and agent-based debate (COLA, MPRF) -- on four datasets with 14 subtasks, using 15 LLMs from six model families with parameter sizes from 7B to 72B+. Our experiments yield several findings. First, on all models with complete results, the best prompt-based method outperforms the best agent-based method, while agent methods require 7 to 12 times more API calls per sample. Second, model scale has a larger impact on performance than method choice, with gains plateauing around 32B. Third, reasoning-enhanced models (DeepSeek-R1) do not consistently outperform general models of the same size on this task.

AI.tldr: 本文系统比较了立场检测任务中五类方法（提示推理和智能体辩论）在14个子任务、15个LLM上的表现，发现提示方法优于辩论方法且成本更低，模型规模（约32B后饱和）比方法选择更关键，推理增强模型并无一致优势。
AI.motivation: 现有立场检测研究在数据划分、基座模型和评估协议上不一致，导致公平比较困难，亟需系统化的统一对比分析。
AI.method: 在4个数据集的14个子任务上，使用15个来自6个模型家族的LLM（7B-72B+），系统比较了5种方法：提示推理类（Direct Prompting、Auto-CoT、StSQA）和智能体辩论类（COLA、MPRF）。
AI.result: 提示类方法全面优于辩论类方法；辩论方法每次样本调用API次数多7-12倍；模型规模对性能影响大于方法选择，增益在32B左右趋于饱和；推理增强模型（如DeepSeek-R1）并未一致优于同规模通用模型。
AI.conclusion: 立场检测中提示推理方法性价比更高，模型规模是关键因素但存在边际递减，推理增强并非万能。

title: DSIPA: Detecting LLM-Generated Texts via Sentiment-Invariant Patterns Divergence Analysis
summary: The rapid advancement of large language models (LLMs) presents new security challenges, particularly in detecting machine-generated text used for misinformation, impersonation, and content forgery. Most existing detection approaches struggle with robustness against adversarial perturbation, paraphrasing attacks, and domain shifts, often requiring restrictive access to model parameters or large labeled datasets. To address this, we propose DSIPA, a novel training-free framework that detects LLM-generated content by quantifying sentiment distributional stability under controlled stylistic variation. It is based on the observation that LLMs typically exhibit more emotionally consistent outputs, while human-written texts display greater affective variation. Our framework operates in a zero-shot, black-box manner, leveraging two unsupervised metrics, sentiment distribution consistency and sentiment distribution preservation, to capture these intrinsic behavioral asymmetries without the need for parameter updates or probability access. Extensive experiments are conducted on state-of-the-art proprietary and open-source models, including GPT-5.2, Gemini-1.5-pro, Claude-3, and LLaMa-3.3. Evaluations on five domains, such as news articles, programming code, student essays, academic papers, and community comments, demonstrate that DSIPA improves F1 detection scores by up to 49.89% over baseline methods. The framework exhibits superior generalizability across domains and strong resilience to adversarial conditions, providing a robust and interpretable behavioral signal for secure content identification in the evolving LLM landscape.

AI.tldr: DSIPA是一个无需训练的零样本黑盒检测框架，通过量化情感分布稳定性来区分LLM生成文本与人类写作，在多个领域和对抗条件下F1分数提升最高达49.89%。
AI.motivation: 现有的大语言模型生成文本检测方法在对抗扰动、释义攻击和领域迁移下鲁棒性不足，且需要访问模型参数或大量标注数据，难以满足实际安全需求。
AI.method: 提出DSIPA框架，基于LLM输出情感一致性更强而人类文本情感变化更丰富的观察，采用两种无监督指标（情感分布一致性与情感分布保持度）在零样本、黑盒条件下进行检测，无需参数更新或概率访问。
AI.result: 在GPT-5.2、Gemini-1.5-pro、Claude-3和LLaMa-3.3等模型上，覆盖新闻、代码、学生作文、学术论文和社区评论五个领域，F1检测分数相比基线方法最高提升49.89%，展现出优越的跨领域泛化能力和对抗鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: DSIPA通过捕捉情感分布的行为不对称性，提供了一种鲁棒且可解释的零样本黑盒检测方案，为LLM生成内容的可信识别提供了有效安全信号。

title: Event-based Liveness Detection using Temporal Ocular Dynamics: An Exploratory Approach
summary: Face liveness detection has been extensively studied using RGB cameras, achieving strong performance under controlled conditions but often failing to generalize across sensors and attack scenarios. In this work, we explore event cameras as an alternative sensing modality for liveness detection based on temporal ocular dynamics. Event cameras capture sparse, asynchronous changes in brightness with microsecond resolution, enabling precise analysis of fast eye movements such as saccades. Replay attacks cannot faithfully reproduce these dynamics due to temporal resampling and display artifacts, leading to distinctive spatio-temporal patterns in the event domain. We design a data collection protocol to extend RGBE-Gaze with replay-attack recordings, yielding an event-based fake counterpart for liveness detection. We analyze event-driven temporal features from eye regions and evaluate their effectiveness for ocular motion segmentation and liveness classification. Our results show that event-based representations enable reliable discrimination between genuine and replayed sequences, achieving up to 95.37% top-1 accuracy with a spiking convolutional neural network. These preliminary findings highlight the potential of event-based sensing for robust and low-latency liveness detection.

AI.tldr: 本文探索使用事件相机（Event Camera）进行人脸活体检测，利用其微秒级时间分辨率捕捉眼动动态（如扫视），能有效区分真实人脸与重放攻击，基于Spiking CNN达到95.37%的top-1准确率。
AI.motivation: 传统RGB相机做活体检测在受控条件下表现良好，但在跨传感器和攻击场景下泛化能力差。事件相机的高时间分辨率特性天然适合捕捉快速眼动，有望解决这一问题。
AI.method: 基于事件相机采集眨眼/扫视等时间眼动数据，扩展RGBE-Gaze数据集加入重放攻击样本；提取事件域时空特征，使用Spiking CNN进行眼部运动分割和活体分类。
AI.result: 事件相机捕捉的眼动特征能可靠区分真实与重放序列，Spiking CNN达到95.37%的top-1准确率。
AI.conclusion: 事件相机在鲁棒、低延迟的活体检测领域具有潜力，为应对重放攻击提供了一种新思路。

title: A Dual-Task Paradigm to Investigate Sentence Comprehension Strategies in Language Models
summary: Language models (LMs) behave more like humans when their cognitive resources are restricted, particularly in predicting sentence processing costs such as reading times. However, it remains unclear whether such constraints similarly affect sentence comprehension strategies. Besides, existing methods do not directly target the balance between memory storage and sentence processing, which is central to human working memory. To address this issue, we propose a dual-task paradigm that combines an arithmetic computation task with a sentence comprehension task, such as "The 2 cocktail + blended 3 =..." Our experiments show that under dual-task conditions, GPT-4o, o3-mini, and o4-mini shift toward plausibility-based comprehension, mirroring humans' rational inference. Specifically, these models show a greater accuracy gap between plausible sentences (e.g., "The cocktail was blended by the bartender") and implausible sentences (e.g., "The bartender was blended by the cocktail") in the dual-task condition compared to the single-task conditions. These findings suggest that constraints on the balance between memory and processing resources promote rational inference in LMs. More broadly, they support the view that human-like sentence comprehension fundamentally arises from the allocation of limited cognitive resources.

AI.tldr: 本文提出双任务范式（算术+句子理解），发现GPT-4o、o3-mini、o4-mini在认知资源受限时更倾向于基于合理性的句子理解，与人类理性推理行为一致，表明有限的认知资源分配是类人句子理解的基础。
AI.motivation: 现有研究已表明语言模型在认知资源受限时更类人地预测阅读时间，但尚不明确这种约束是否影响句子理解策略；且现有方法未直接针对人类工作记忆中记忆存储与句子处理之间的平衡。
AI.method: 提出双任务范式，将算术计算任务与句子理解任务结合（如"The 2 cocktail + blended 3 =..."）；在单任务和双任务条件下分别测试GPT-4o、o3-mini、o4-mini对合理句（如"鸡尾酒由调酒师调制"）与不合理句（如"调酒师由鸡尾酒调制"）的理解准确性。
AI.result: 双任务条件下，模型在合理句与不合理句之间的准确率差距显著大于单任务条件，表明模型转向基于合理性的理解策略。
AI.conclusion: 记忆与处理资源之间的约束促进了语言模型中的理性推理，支持了类人句子理解从根本上来源于有限认知资源分配的观点。

title: Shorthand for Thought: Compressing LLM Reasoning via Entropy-Guided Supertokens
summary: Reasoning in Large Language Models incurs significant inference-time compute, yet the token-level information structure of reasoning traces remains underexplored. We observe that reasoning tokens split into two functional types: low-entropy \textit{structural} tokens (recurring phrases that scaffold the reasoning process) and higher-entropy \textit{organic} tokens (problem-specific content that drives toward a solution). This asymmetry motivates a simple, model-agnostic compression pipeline: apply cross-word BPE merges on a model's own reasoning traces to derive \textit{supertokens} that capture frequent structural patterns, then teach the model to adopt them via supervised fine-tuning. Across three model families and five mathematical reasoning benchmarks, our approach shortens reasoning traces by 8.1\% on average with no statistically significant accuracy loss on any model--benchmark pair. Beyond compression, supertokens act as interpretable reasoning-move annotations (backtracking, verification, strategy shifts), exposing the model's high-level strategy at a glance. Analyzing transitions between structural categories reveals systematic differences between correct and incorrect traces: correct traces show productive recovery (backtracking followed by strategy shifts and verification), while incorrect traces are dominated by confusion cycles (repeated hedging and unresolved contradictions). These diagnostic signals suggest applications in reward shaping and early stopping for RL-based reasoning training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于超标记（supertokens）的推理压缩方法，通过识别推理轨迹中的低熵结构标记与高熵有机标记，采用跨词BPE合并生成超标记，将推理长度平均缩短8.1%且不损失准确性。超标记还可作为可解释的推理动作注释，揭示正确与错误轨迹的结构差异。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型推理过程消耗大量计算资源，但推理标记的token级信息结构尚未被充分探索。作者观察到推理标记存在低熵结构标记和高熵有机标记的功能性区分，希望利用这一不对称性实现推理压缩与可解释性分析。
AI.method: 1) 识别推理轨迹中的结构标记（低熵、重复性短语）和有机标记（高熵、问题特定内容）；2) 对模型自身的推理轨迹应用跨词BPE合并，生成捕获频繁结构模式的超标记；3) 通过监督微调让模型学习采用这些超标记。
AI.result: 在三种模型家族和五个数学推理基准上，推理轨迹平均缩短8.1%，所有模型-基准组合均无统计显著的准确率损失。超标记可暴露模型的高层策略，正确轨迹表现为生产性恢复（回溯→策略转换→验证），错误轨迹表现为混乱循环（重复回避和未解决的矛盾）。
AI.conclusion: 超标记不仅实现有效压缩，还提供可解释的推理动作注释及诊断信号，可应用于基于强化学习的推理训练中的奖励塑形和早停策略。

title: The Unseen Adversaries: Robust and Generalized Defense Against Adversarial Patches
summary: The vulnerabilities of deep neural networks against singularities have raised serious concerns regarding their deployment in the physical world. One of the most prominent and impactful physical-world adversarial perturbations is the attachment of patches to clean images, known as an adversarial patch attack. Similarly, natural noises such as Gaussian and Salt\&Pepper are highly prevalent in the real world. The current research need arises from the above vulnerabilities and the lack of efforts to tackle these two singularities independently and, especially, in combination. In this research, we have, for the first time, combined these two prominent singularities and proposed a novel dataset. Using this dataset, we have conducted a benchmark study of singularity data-point detection using features from several convolutional neural networks. For classification, rather than the popular neural network-based parameter tuning, we have used traditional yet effective machine learning classifiers. The extensive experiments across various in- and out-of-distribution (OOD) singularities reveal several interesting findings about the effectiveness of classifiers and show that it is hard to defend against adversaries when they are treated independently, and inefficient classifiers are selected.

AI.tldr: 本文首次将对抗性补丁攻击与自然噪声（高斯、椒盐噪声）相结合，构建新数据集，并使用传统机器学习分类器（而非神经网络）基于CNN特征进行奇异点检测的基准研究。
AI.motivation: 深度神经网络在物理世界中面对对抗性补丁攻击和自然噪声等奇异点存在脆弱性，目前缺乏同时处理这两种奇异点的研究工作。
AI.method: 构建结合对抗性补丁与自然噪声的新数据集；使用多种CNN提取特征，配合传统机器学习分类器（非神经网络调参）进行奇异点检测；在分布内和分布外场景下进行广泛实验。
AI.result: 实验揭示了不同分类器在多种奇异点检测中的有效性差异，发现单独处理对抗攻击难以防御，且选择低效分类器会影响防御效果。
AI.conclusion: 传统机器学习分类器结合CNN特征可用于奇异点检测，但单独处理对抗性奇异点难以有效防御，需选用合适分类器。

title: Text Style Transfer with Machine Translation for Graphic Designs
summary: Globalization of graphic designs such as those used in marketing materials and magazines is increasingly important for communication to broad audiences. To accomplish this, the textual content in the graphic designs needs to be accurately translated and have the text styling preserved in order to fit visually into the design. Preserving text styling requires high accuracy word alignment between the original and the translated text. The problem of word alignment between source and translated text is long known. The industry standards for extracting word alignments are defined by Giza++ and attention probabilities from neural machine translation (NMT) models. In this paper, we explore three new methods to tackle the word alignment problem for transferring text styles from the source to the translated text. The proposed methods are developed on top of commercially available NMT and LLM translation technologies. They include: NMT with custom input and output tags for text styling; LLM with custom input and output tags; a hybrid with NMT for translation followed by an LLM with use of unigram mappings. To analyze the performance of these solutions, their alignment results are compared with the results of an attention head approach to gauge their usability in graphic design applications. Interestingly, the attention head strong baseline proves more accurate than the LLM or NMT approach and on par with the hybrid NMT+LLM approach.

AI.tldr: 本文探索了三种基于NMT和LLM的新方法来解决图形设计中源文本与翻译文本间的词对齐问题，以保留文本样式。实验发现，注意力头基线方法比单纯LLM或NMT更准确，与混合NMT+LLM方法性能相当。
AI.motivation: 全球化背景下，图形设计中的文本需要准确翻译并保留原有样式，而高精度的词对齐是保留文本样式的关键。
AI.method: 提出了三种方法：1) 带自定义输入输出标签的NMT；2) 带自定义输入输出标签的LLM；3) NMT翻译后结合LLM与unigram映射的混合方法。并与注意力头基线方法进行对比。
AI.result: 注意力头基线方法的对齐准确率高于纯LLM或纯NMT方法，与混合NMT+LLM方法性能相当。
AI.conclusion: 对于图形设计中的文本样式迁移任务，简单的注意力头方法依然是一个强基线，而混合方法也有潜力，但纯LLM或NMT方法效果不如预期。

title: SG-UniBuc-NLP at SemEval-2026 Task 6: Multi-Head RoBERTa with Chunking for Long-Context Evasion Detection
comment: Accepted to SemEval-2026 (Task 6: CLARITY: Unmasking Political Question Evasions)
summary: We describe our system for SemEval-2026 Task 6 (CLARITY: Unmasking Political Question Evasions), which classifies English political interview responses by coarse-grained clarity (3-way) and fine-grained evasion strategy (9-way). Since responses frequently exceed the 512-token limit of standard Transformer encoders, we apply an overlapping sliding-window chunking strategy with element-wise Max-Pooling aggregation over chunk representations. A shared RoBERTa-large encoder supplies two task-specific heads trained jointly via a multi-task objective, with inference-time ensembling over 7-fold stratified cross-validation. Our system achieves a Macro-F1 of 0.80 on Subtask 1 and 0.51 on Subtask 2, ranking 11th in both subtasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于RoBERTa-large的多任务学习系统，通过滑动窗口切分和最大池化聚合处理长文本，用于政治访谈回答的粗粒度清晰度分类（3类）和细粒度回避策略分类（9类），在SemEval-2026任务中两项子任务均排名第11。
AI.motivation: 政治访谈中的回答往往存在模糊、回避等现象，现有模型难以有效区分回答的清晰程度和具体回避策略，且标准Transformer编码器受限于512 token长度，无法直接处理长文本回答。
AI.method: 采用重叠滑动窗口切分策略将长回答分割为多个片段，通过逐元素最大池化聚合各片段的表示；使用共享的RoBERTa-large编码器，连接两个任务特定的分类头，通过多任务目标联合训练；推理时对7折分层交叉验证的模型进行集成。
AI.result: 在子任务1（粗粒度3分类）上取得Macro-F1为0.80，在子任务2（细粒度9分类）上取得Macro-F1为0.51，两项子任务均排名第11位。
AI.conclusion: 该方案证明了多任务学习与滑动窗口池化策略在处理长文本政治回避检测任务上的有效性，但在细粒度分类上仍有较大提升空间。

title: Motion-Driven Multi-Object Tracking of Model Organisms in Space Science Experiments
comment: 2026 IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition Workshops (CVPRW)
summary: Automated animal behavior analysis relies on long-term, interpretable individual trajectories; however, multi-animal tracking in space science experimental videos remains highly challenging due to weak appearance cues, low-quality imaging, complex maneuvering behaviors, and frequent interactions. To address this problem, we first construct the SpaceAnimal-MOT dataset to characterize the motion complexity and long-term identity preservation challenges in biological videos acquired under microgravity conditions. We then propose ART-Track (Adaptive Robust Tracking), a motion-driven tracking framework tailored to this setting. Specifically, multi-model motion estimation is introduced to handle abrupt maneuvers and nonlinear motion, motion-state-driven association is designed to reduce identity switches under dense interactions and temporary mismatch, and uncertainty-adaptive fusion is used to dynamically balance spatial and motion cues when prediction reliability varies. Experimental results show that ART-Track significantly reduces identity switches on zebrafish and fruitfly sequences, while maintaining more stable association under occlusion, deformation, and high-density interactions, thereby providing a more reliable tracking foundation for downstream quantitative behavior analysis. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/yyy7777777/ART_TRACK/tree/main.

AI.tldr: 本文针对微重力环境下多动物跟踪难题，构建了SpaceAnimal-MOT数据集，并提出了基于运动驱动的ART-Track跟踪框架，通过多模型运动估计、运动状态驱动关联和不确定性自适应融合，显著减少了斑马鱼和果蝇序列中的身份切换，为下游行为分析提供了更可靠的跟踪基础。
AI.motivation: 太空科学实验视频中多动物跟踪面临外观线索弱、成像质量低、机动行为复杂和频繁交互等挑战，现有方法难以实现长期、可解释的个体轨迹追踪，亟需针对微重力环境的专用跟踪方案。
AI.method: 1) 构建SpaceAnimal-MOT数据集；2) 提出ART-Track框架，包含多模型运动估计处理突机动和非线性运动、运动状态驱动关联减少密集交互下的身份切换、不确定性自适应融合动态平衡空间与运动线索。
AI.result: 在斑马鱼和果蝇序列上，ART-Track显著降低了身份切换次数，在遮挡、变形和高密度交互下保持了更稳定的关联。
AI.conclusion: ART-Track为微重力环境下的多动物跟踪提供了更可靠的方案，有助于下游定量行为分析，代码已开源。

title: Benchmarking Complex Multimodal Document Processing Pipelines: A Unified Evaluation Framework for Enterprise AI
comment: 16 pages, 4 tables. Code, metrics, and pilot data to be released upon publication
summary:
Most enterprise document AI today is a pipeline. Parse, index, retrieve, generate. Each of those stages has been studied to death on its own -- what's still hard is evaluating the system as a whole.
  We built EnterpriseDocBench to take a swing at it: parsing fidelity, indexing efficiency, retrieval relevance, and generation groundedness, all on the same corpus. The corpus is built from public, permissively licensed documents across six enterprise domains (five represented in the current pilot). We ran three pipelines through it -- BM25, dense embedding, and a hybrid -- all with the same GPT-5 generator.
  The headline numbers: hybrid retrieval narrowly beats BM25 (nDCG@5 of 0.92 vs. 0.91), and both beat dense embedding (0.83). Hallucination doesn't grow monotonically with document length -- short documents and very long ones both hallucinate more than medium ones (28.1% and 23.8% vs. 9.2%). Cross-stage correlations are very weak: parsing->retrieval r=0.14, parsing->generation r=0.17, retrieval->generation 0.02. If quality were cascading the way most of us assume, those numbers would be much higher; they aren't. Design caveats are real (parsing fixed, generator shared, automated proxy metrics) and we don't oversell the result.
  One result that genuinely surprised us: factual accuracy on stated claims is 85.5%, but answer completeness averages 0.40. The system is right when it answers -- it just leaves things out. That gap matters more for real deployments than the headline accuracy number does.
  We also describe three reference architectures (ColPali, ColQwen2, agentic complexity-based routing) which are not yet integrated end-to-end. Framework, metrics, baselines, and collection scripts will be released open-source on acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了EnterpriseDocBench，一个端到端的企业文档AI评估框架。在六个企业领域的公开文档上，测试了三种RAG流水线（BM25、稠密嵌入、混合检索）。主要发现：混合检索略优于BM25（nDCG@5 0.92 vs 0.91）；幻觉率不随文档长度单调增长，中等长度文档最低（9.2%）；各阶段间相关性极弱（r≤0.17），挑战了"级联质量下降"的常识；回答完整性仅0.40，远低于事实准确率85.5%，说明系统"答对但不全面"的问题更值得关注。
AI.motivation: 现有企业文档AI研究多聚焦于单个阶段（解析、索引、检索、生成），缺乏对整体系统的端到端评估方法和基准，导致难以衡量实际部署中的系统级性能。
AI.method: 构建EnterpriseDocBench基准，包含六个企业领域（当前试点五个）的公开许可文档；设计四个评估维度（解析保真度、索引效率、检索相关性、生成基于性）；运行三种流水线（BM25、稠密嵌入、混合检索），使用统一GPT-5生成器；采用自动化代理指标进行评估。
AI.result: 混合检索nDCG@5=0.92略优于BM25的0.91，两者均优于稠密嵌入的0.83；中等长度文档幻觉率最低（9.2%），短文档（28.1%）和长文档（23.8%）更高；跨阶段相关性极弱（r≤0.17）；事实准确率85.5%，但回答完整性仅0.40。
AI.conclusion: 系统级质量并非各阶段质量的简单级联，各阶段间弱相关性表明优化单个阶段不一定改善整体；回答不完整比事实错误对实际部署的影响更大；需要更多端到端评估研究，并设计了三种参考架构（ColPali、ColQwen2、基于智能体复杂度的路由）作为未来方向。

title: When Hidden States Drift: Can KV Caches Rescue Long-Range Speculative Decoding?
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates LLM inference, but SOTA hidden-state-based drafters suffer from long-range decay: draft accuracy degrades as the speculative step increases. Existing work attributes this decay to train-inference mismatch and proposes test-time training (TTT) as a remedy, yet we observe that long-range decay persists even in TTT-trained drafters. We revisit long-range decay from the perspective of context information preservation. In hidden-state reuse, we argue the target hidden state acts as a biased context compression: it aggregates historical token information according to the attention query at the current position, yielding a compact representation optimized for immediate next-token prediction. This compression can suppress information less relevant to the current query but important for later speculative steps. In contrast, the target model's KV cache serves as an explicit context, retaining the complete set of token-wise KV representations. We therefore posit the KV-Reuse Hypothesis: allowing the draft model to reuse the target KV cache can provide richer signals for long-horizon drafting. To test this hypothesis, we introduce KVShot, a diagnostic framework that compares three reuse paradigms: hidden-only, KV-only, and hybrid. Extensive evaluations on Qwen3-8B show that KV-Reuse improves long-range acceptance, although end-to-end speedups remain marginal under current training pipelines. Our analysis identifies two key structural bottlenecks: shallow drafters struggle to estimate target queries accurately, and draft-side KV projections receive sparse gradient signals. These findings suggest that realizing the full potential of KV-aware decoding requires moving beyond TTT toward block-wise training paradigms. By exposing these bottlenecks, KVShot provides a foundational diagnostic testbed and a clear roadmap for designing next-generation inference architectures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出KV-Reuse假设，认为让草稿模型复用目标模型的KV缓存能提供更丰富的长程推测信号，并通过KVShot框架验证了KV-Reuse可提升长程接受率，但端到端加速仍受限于训练范式和结构瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 现有基于隐藏状态的草稿模型在推测解码中存在长程衰减问题，即使采用测试时训练仍无法解决。作者从上下文信息保存角度重新审视这一问题，认为目标隐藏状态是有偏的上下文压缩，可能抑制对后续推测步骤重要的信息。
AI.method: 提出KV-Reuse假设，并构建KVShot诊断框架，对比三种复用范式：仅隐藏状态、仅KV缓存、混合复用。在Qwen3-8B上进行评估。
AI.result: KV-Reuse提升了长程接受率，但端到端加速在现有训练流程下仍有限。识别出两个结构瓶颈：浅层草稿模型难以准确估计目标查询，草稿侧KV投影梯度信号稀疏。
AI.conclusion: 要充分发挥KV感知解码的潜力，需要超越测试时训练，转向块级训练范式。KVShot为设计下一代推理架构提供了基础诊断平台和清晰路线图。

title: SpatialFusion: Endowing Unified Image Generation with Intrinsic 3D Geometric Awareness
summary: Recent unified image generation models have achieved remarkable success by employing MLLMs for semantic understanding and diffusion backbones for image generation. However, these models remain fundamentally limited in spatially-aware tasks due to a lack of intrinsic spatial understanding and the absence of explicit geometric guidance during generation. In this paper, we propose SpatialFusion, a novel framework that internalizes 3D geometric awareness into unified image generation models. Specifically, we first employ a Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) architecture to augment the MLLM with a parallel spatial transformer to enhance 3D geometric modeling capability. By sharing self-attention with the MLLM, the spatial transformer learns to derive metric-depth maps of target images from rich semantic contexts. These explicit geometric scaffolds are then injected into the diffusion backbone through a specialized depth adapter, providing precise spatial constraints for spatially-coherent image generation. Through a progressive two-stage training strategy, SpatialFusion significantly enhances performance on spatially-aware benchmarks, notably outperforming leading models such as GPT-4o. Additionally, it achieves generalized performance gains across both text-to-image generation and image editing scenarios, all while maintaining negligible inference overhead.

AI.tldr: SpatialFusion通过将3D几何感知融入统一图像生成模型，在空间感知任务上显著超越了GPT-4o等领先模型。
AI.motivation: 现有统一图像生成模型缺乏内在空间理解能力和显式几何引导，在空间感知任务中表现有限。
AI.method: 采用Mixture-of-Transformers架构增强MLLM的3D几何建模能力，通过共享自注意力学习度量深度图，并利用深度适配器将几何骨架注入扩散主干，配合两阶段渐进训练策略。
AI.result: 在空间感知基准上显著超越GPT-4o等领先模型，在文生图和图像编辑场景中均取得通用性能提升，且推理开销可忽略不计。
AI.conclusion: SpatialFusion通过显式几何引导有效提升了统一图像生成模型的空间感知能力，为未来几何感知生成模型提供了新思路。

title: Which Face and Whose Identity? Solving the Dual Challenge of Deepfake Proactive Forensics in Multi-Face Scenarios
summary: Unlike single-face forgeries, deepfakes in complex multi-person interaction scenarios (such as group photos and multi-person meetings) more closely reflect real-world threats. Although existing proactive forensics solutions demonstrate good performance, they heavily rely on a "single-face" setting, making it difficult to effectively address the problems of deepfake localization and source tracing in complex multi-person environments. To address this challenge, we propose the Deep Attributable Watermarking Framework (DAWF). This framework adopts a novel multi-face encoder-decoder architecture that bypasses the cumbersome offline pre-processing steps of traditional forensics, facilitating efficient in-network parallel watermark embedding and cross-face collaborative processing. Crucially, we propose a selective regional supervision loss. This innovative mechanism guides the decoder to focus exclusively on the facial regions tampered with by deepfakes. Leveraging this mechanism alongside the embedded identity payloads, DAWF realizes the "which + who" goal, answering the dual questions of which facial region was forged and who was forged. Extensive experiments on challenging multi-face datasets show that DAWF achieves excellent deepfake localization and traceability in complex multi-person scenes.

AI.tldr: DAWF提出了一种面向多人交互场景的深度可归属水印框架，通过多脸编解码架构和选择性区域监督损失，实现了对多脸场景中深度伪造区域的精准定位与身份溯源（"which + who"目标）。
AI.motivation: 现有主动取证方案在单脸场景表现良好，但在复杂多人交互环境（如合影、多人会议）中难以有效定位伪造区域和溯源，无法应对真实的群体伪造威胁。
AI.method: 提出Deep Attributable Watermarking Framework (DAWF)，采用新颖的多脸编解码器架构，支持网络内并行水印嵌入与跨脸协同处理；并提出选择性区域监督损失，引导解码器聚焦于被深度伪造篡改的面部区域。
AI.result: 在具有挑战性的多脸数据集上，DAWF在复杂多人场景下实现了优异的深度伪造定位与溯源性能。
AI.conclusion: DAWF有效解决了多人交互场景中的深度伪造定位与溯源问题，实现了"哪个区域被伪造 + 谁被伪造"的双重目标。

title: Naamah: A Large Scale Synthetic Sanskrit NER Corpus via DBpedia Seeding and LLM Generation
summary: The digitisation of classical Sanskrit literature is impeded by a scarcity of annotated resources, particularly for Named Entity Recognition. While recent methodologies utilise generic Large Language Models (LLMs) for data augmentation, these approaches remain prone to error and often lack the reasoning depth required for classical grammar. In this work, we introduce Naamah, a high quality silver standard Sanskrit NER dataset comprising 102,942 sentences. We propose a methodology that combines entity extraction from DBpedia with the generative capabilities of a 24B parameter hybrid reasoning model to create grammatically natural and synthetically diverse training data. We utilize this dataset to benchmark two transformer architectures: the massive multilingual XLM RoBERTa and the parameter efficient IndicBERTv2.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Naamah数据集（10万+句子）和混合推理方法，用于解决梵语命名实体识别中标注资源匮乏的问题，并基于该数据集对XLM RoBERTa和IndicBERTv2两种 transformer 架构进行了基准测试。
AI.motivation: 古典梵语文学数字化受限于标注资源稀缺，尤其缺少命名实体识别（NER）的标注数据；现有LLM数据增强方法容易出错且缺乏古典语法所需的推理深度。
AI.method: 结合DBpedia实体抽取与24B参数混合推理模型的生成能力，构建高质量银标准梵语NER数据集Naamah（102,942句），并用于评估XLM RoBERTa和IndicBERTv2两种架构。
AI.result: 生成了包含102,942句的高质量银标准数据集，并在两种transformer架构上进行了基准测试。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的混合推理方法能够有效生成语法自然且多样化的训练数据，为解决古典梵语NER标注资源稀缺问题提供了可行方案。

title: ACPO: Anchor-Constrained Perceptual Optimization for Diffusion Models with No-Reference Quality Guidance
summary: Diffusion models have achieved remarkable success in image generation, yet their training is predominantly driven by full-reference objectives that enforce pixel-wise similarity to ground-truth images.Such supervision, while effective for fidelity, may insufficient in terms of subjective visual perception quality and text-image semantic consistency. In this work, we investigate the problem of incorporating no-reference perceptual quality into diffusion training. A key challenge is that directly optimizing perceptual signals, such as those provided by no-reference image quality assessment (NR-IQA) models, introduces a mismatch with the original diffusion objective, leading to training instability and distributional drift during fine-tuning. To address this issue, we propose an anchor-constrained optimization framework that enables stable perceptual adaptation. Specifically, we leverage a learned NR-IQA model as a perceptual guidance signal, while introducing an anchor-based regularization that enforces consistency with the base diffusion model in terms of noise prediction. This design effectively balances perceptual quality improvement and generative fidelity, allowing controlled adaptation toward perceptually favorable outputs without compromising the original generative behavior. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method consistently enhances perceptual quality while preserving generation diversity and training stability, highlighting the effectiveness of anchor-constrained perceptual optimization for diffusion models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种锚点约束优化框架，通过在扩散模型训练中引入无参考图像质量评估（NR-IQA）信号，在保持生成保真度和稳定性的同时，显著提升图像的感知质量和文本-图像语义一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有的扩散模型训练主要依赖全参考目标（如逐像素相似性），虽然能保证图像 fidelity，但在主观视觉感知质量和文本-图像语义一致性方面存在不足。作者希望将无参考感知质量信号融入扩散训练中。
AI.method: 提出锚点约束优化框架：利用学习到的NR-IQA模型作为感知引导信号，同时引入基于锚点的正则化项，强制微调后的模型与基础扩散模型在噪声预测上保持一致，从而在感知质量提升与生成保真度之间取得平衡。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法能持续提升感知质量，同时保持生成多样性和训练稳定性，验证了锚点约束感知优化的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 锚点约束优化框架成功地将无参考感知质量信号融入扩散模型训练，解决了直接优化感知信号带来的训练不稳定和分布漂移问题，实现了感知质量与生成保真度的良好平衡。

title: Theory-Grounded Evaluation Exposes the Authorship Gap in LLM Personalization
summary: Stylistic personalization - making LLMs write in a specific individual's style, rather than merely adapting to task preferences - lacks evaluation grounded in authorship science. We show that grounding evaluation in authorship verification theory transforms what benchmarks can measure. Drawing on three measurement traditions - LUAR, a trained authorship verification model; an LLM-as-judge with decoupled trait matching; and classical function-word stylometrics - we evaluate four inference-time personalization methods across 50 authors and 1,000 generations. The theory-grounded metric, LUAR, provides what ad hoc alternatives cannot: calibrated baselines, with a human ceiling of 0.756 and a cross-author floor of 0.626, that give scores absolute meaning. All methods score below this floor, from 0.484 to 0.508, exposing an authorship gap invisible to uncalibrated metrics. The three metrics produce near-zero pairwise correlations, with absolute r less than 0.07, confirming that without theoretical grounding, metric choice determines conclusions: an LLM judge declares a clear winner while LUAR finds no meaningful differentiation. These findings demonstrate the theory-benchmark cycle in action: authorship theory exposes evaluation failures that ad hoc benchmarks miss.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于作者身份验证理论（如LUAR模型）的风格个性化评估框架，发现传统指标因缺乏理论校准而无法揭示LLM风格模仿的真实缺陷：所有方法得分均低于随机基线，且不同指标间相关性极低（r<0.07），证明指标选择直接决定结论。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM风格个性化评估缺乏作者身份科学（authorship science）的理论基础，导致评估不可靠、结论不一致。
AI.method: 基于三个测量传统（LUAR验证模型、LLM-as-judge解耦特征匹配、功能词风格测量），评估四种推理时个性化方法，覆盖50位作者和1000个生成样本。
AI.result: LUAR提供了校准基线（人类上限0.756，跨作者下限0.626），所有方法得分（0.484-0.508）均低于下限；三种指标间几乎零相关（|r|<0.07），LLM判断有明确赢家而LUAR认为无显著差异。
AI.conclusion: 揭示了理论-基准循环（theory-benchmark cycle）：作者身份理论暴露了临时基准忽视的评估失败，指标选择决定了研究结论。

title: GateMOT: Q-Gated Attention for Dense Object Tracking
summary: While large models demonstrate the strong representational power of vanilla attention, this core mechanism cannot be directly applied to Dense Object Tracking: its quadratic all-to-all interactions are computationally prohibitive for dense motion estimation on high-resolution features. This mismatch prevents Dense Object Tracking from fully leveraging attention-based modeling in crowded and occlusion-heavy scenes. To address this challenge, we introduce GateMOT, an online tracking framework centered on Q-Gated Attention (Q-Attention), an efficient and spatially aware attention variant. Our key idea is to repurpose the Query from a similarity-conditioning term into a learnable gating unit. This Gating-Query (Gating-Q) produces a probabilistic gate that modulates Key features in an element-wise manner, enabling explicit relevance selection instead of costly global aggregation. Built on this mechanism, parallel Q-Attention heads transform one shared feature map into task-specific yet consistent representations for detection, motion, and re-identification, yielding a tightly coupled multi-task decoder with linear-complexity gating operations. GateMOT achieves state-of-the-art HOTA of 48.4, MOTA of 67.8, and IDF1 of 64.5 on BEE24, and demonstrates strong performance on additional Dense Object Tracking benchmarks. These results show that Q-Attention is a simple, effective, and transferable building block for attention-based tracking in dense tracking scenarios.

AI.tldr: GateMOT提出了一种基于Q门控注意力（Q-Attention）的高效密集目标跟踪框架，通过将Query重用于门控单元实现线性复杂度的注意力机制，在BEE24等基准上取得了SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 标准注意力机制的二次方全交互计算复杂度无法直接应用于高分辨率特征的密集运动估计，导致密集目标跟踪在拥挤和严重遮挡场景中无法充分利用基于注意力的建模能力。
AI.method: 提出Q门控注意力（Q-Attention），将Query从相似性条件项重新设计为可学习的门控单元（Gating-Q），生成概率门以逐元素方式调制Key特征，实现显式相关性选择而非昂贵的全局聚合；并基于此机制构建并行多头注意力，将共享特征图转化为检测、运动、重识别等多任务特定且一致的表示。
AI.result: 在BEE24数据集上取得HOTA 48.4、MOTA 67.8、IDF1 64.5的SOTA结果，并在其他密集目标跟踪基准上表现强劲。
AI.conclusion: Q-Attention是一种简单、有效且可迁移的注意力构建模块，适用于密集跟踪场景中的基于注意力的跟踪方法。

title: CO-EVO: Co-evolving Semantic Anchoring and Style Diversification for Federated DG-ReID
summary: Federated domain generalization for person re-identification (FedDG-ReID) aims to collaboratively train a pedestrian retrieval model across multiple decentralized source domains such that it can generalize to unseen target environments without compromising raw data privacy. However, this task is significantly challenged by the inherent stylistic gaps across decentralized clients. Without global supervision, models easily succumb to shortcut learning where representations overfit to domain specific camera biases rather than universal identity features. We propose CO-EVO, a novel federated framework that resolves this semantic-style conflict through a co-evolutionary mechanism. On the semantic side, Camera-Invariant Semantic Anchoring (CSA) learns identity prompts with cross-camera consistency to establish purified and domain-agnostic anchors that filter out local imaging noise. On the visual side, Global Style Diversification (GSD), powered by a Global Camera-Style Bank (GCSB), synthesizes realistic perturbations to expand the visual boundaries of training data. The core of CO-EVO is its co-evolutionary loop where purified anchors act as gravitational centers to guide the image encoder toward robust anatomical attributes amidst diverse style variations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CO-EVO achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance, proving that the synergy between semantic purification and style expansion is essential for robust cross-domain generalization. Our code is available at: https://github.com/NanYiyuzurn/ACL-LGPS-2026.

AI.tldr: 提出CO-EVO联邦学习框架，通过语义净化（CSA）与风格扩展（GSD）协同进化，解决联邦域泛化行人重识别中跨域风格差异导致的捷径学习问题，实现SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 联邦域泛化行人重识别（FedDG-ReID）面临客户端间固有风格差异的挑战，模型容易陷入捷径学习——过拟合领域特定的相机偏差而非通用身份特征，且无法通过全局监督解决。
AI.method: 提出CO-EVO框架，包含两个核心机制：(1) 语义侧：相机不变语义锚定（CSA）学习具有跨相机一致性的身份提示，建立纯净的域无关锚点以过滤局部成像噪声；(2) 视觉侧：全局风格多样化（GSD）借助全局相机风格库（GCSB）合成真实扰动扩展训练数据视觉边界。二者通过协同进化循环相互作用。
AI.result: 大量实验证明CO-EVO达到SOTA性能，验证了语义净化与风格扩展的协同作用对于鲁棒跨域泛化的必要性。
AI.conclusion: 语义净化与风格扩展的协同进化是解决联邦域泛化行人重识别中风格-语义冲突的关键，为跨域泛化提供了有效路径。

title: Tree-of-Text: A Tree-based Prompting Framework for Table-to-Text Generation in the Sports Domain
comment: Accepted by ACL SRW 2025: Long Paper (Oral)
summary: Generating sports game reports from structured tables is a complex table-to-text task that demands both precise data interpretation and fluent narrative generation. Traditional model-based approaches require large, annotated datasets, while prompt-based methods using large language models (LLMs) often struggle with hallucination due to weak table comprehension. To overcome these challenges, we propose Tree-of-Text, a tree-structured prompting framework that guides LLMs through a three-stage generation process: (1) Content Planning, where relevant operations and arguments are selected from the input tables; (2) Operation Execution, which breaks down large tables into manageable sub-tables; and (3) Content Generation, where short textual outputs are merged and rewritten into a cohesive report. Experiments show that our method outperforms existing methods on ShuttleSet+, leads in RG and CO metrics on RotoWire-FG, and excels in CS and CO on MLB with roughly 40% of the time and cost of Chain-of-Table. These results demonstrate the effectiveness and efficiency of Tree-of-Text and suggest a promising direction for prompt-based table-to-text generation in the sports domain.

AI.tldr: 提出Tree-of-Text树状提示框架，通过内容规划、操作执行、内容生成三阶段引导LLM生成体育赛事报告，在多个数据集上以更低成本超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 传统模型方法需要大量标注数据，而基于提示的LLM方法因表格理解能力弱易出现幻觉，亟需一种高效且准确的表格到文本生成方法。
AI.method: 提出Tree-of-Text树状结构提示框架，包含三个阶段：(1)内容规划——从输入表中选择相关操作和参数；(2)操作执行——将大表分解为可管理的子表；(3)内容生成——合并并重写短文本输出为连贯报告。
AI.result: 在ShuttleSet+数据集上超越现有方法；在RotoWire-FG数据集上RG和CO指标领先；在MLB数据集上CS和CO指标优异；时间和成本仅为Chain-of-Table的约40%。
AI.conclusion: Tree-of-Text在体育领域表格到文本生成任务中高效且有效，为基于提示的生成方法提供了有前景的方向。

title: Beyond Fixed Formulas: Data-Driven Linear Predictor for Efficient Diffusion Models
summary: To address the high sampling cost of Diffusion Transformers (DiTs), feature caching offers a training-free acceleration method. However, existing methods rely on hand-crafted forecasting formulas that fail under aggressive skipping. We propose L2P (Learnable Linear Predictor), a simple data-driven caching framework that replaces fixed coefficients with learnable per-timestep weights. Rapidly trained in ~20 seconds on a single GPU, L2P accurately reconstructs current features from past trajectories. L2P significantly outperforms existing baselines: it achieves a 4.55x FLOPs reduction and 4.15x latency speedup on FLUX.1-dev, and maintains high visual fidelity under up to 7.18x acceleration on Qwen-Image models, where prior methods show noticeable quality degradation. Our results show learning linear predictors is highly effective for efficient DiT inference. Code is available at https://github.com/Aredstone/L2P-Cache.

AI.tldr: 提出L2P（可学习线性预测器）框架，通过数据驱动的可学习权重替代传统固定系数，实现DiT模型的高效特征缓存加速，仅需20秒训练即可在多种模型上取得4倍以上加速比，且保持高视觉质量。
AI.motivation: 现有DiT特征缓存方法依赖手工设计的预测公式，在激进跳过步数时性能显著下降，需要更鲁棒的数据驱动方案。
AI.method: 提出L2P框架，用每个时间步的可学习权重替代固定系数，通过约20秒的快速训练从历史轨迹中学习预测当前特征。
AI.result: 在FLUX.1-dev上实现4.55倍FLOPs减少和4.15倍延迟加速；在Qwen-Image模型上最高支持7.18倍加速，且优于现有基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 学习线性预测器对于高效DiT推理非常有效，简单数据驱动方法优于复杂手工设计策略。

title: SafeReview: Defending LLM-based Review Systems Against Adversarial Hidden Prompts
summary: As Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly integrated into academic peer review, their vulnerability to adversarial prompts -- adversarial instructions embedded in submissions to manipulate outcomes -- emerges as a critical threat to scholarly integrity. To counter this, we propose a novel adversarial framework where a Generator model, trained to create sophisticated attack prompts, is jointly optimized with a Defender model tasked with their detection. This system is trained using a loss function inspired by Information Retrieval Generative Adversarial Networks, which fosters a dynamic co-evolution between the two models, forcing the Defender to develop robust capabilities against continuously improving attack strategies. The resulting framework demonstrates significantly enhanced resilience to novel and evolving threats compared to static defenses, thereby establishing a critical foundation for securing the integrity of peer review.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种对抗框架，通过生成器与防御器的动态协同进化，提升大语言模型在学术同行评审中对抗恶意攻击的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM被广泛用于学术同行评审，攻击者可通过对抗性提示操纵评审结果，严重威胁学术诚信，现有静态防御难以应对不断演化的攻击。
AI.method: 构建生成器（Generator）与防御器（Defender）联合优化框架，采用基于信息检索GAN的损失函数，驱动两者动态协同进化。
AI.result: 该框架在面对新型和不断演化的攻击时，表现出比静态防御更强的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 该对抗框架为保障学术同行评审的完整性奠定了关键基础。

title: Topology-Aware Representation Alignment for Semi-Supervised Vision-Language Learning
summary: Vision-language models have shown strong performance, but they often generalize poorly to specialized domains. While semi-supervised vision-language learning mitigates this limitation by leveraging a small set of labeled image-text pairs together with abundant unlabeled images, existing methods remain fundamentally pairwise and fail to model the global structure of multimodal representation manifolds. Existing topology-based alignment methods rely on persistence diagram matching, which neither guarantees geometric alignment nor utilizes the image-text pairing information central to vision-language learning. We propose Topology-Aware Multimodal Representation Alignment (ToMA), a framework that uses persistent homology to identify topologically salient edges and aligns them across modalities through available cross-modal correspondences. ToMA leverages both H_0-death edges and lightweight H_1-birth edges, allowing it to capture both connectivity and cycle structure without constructing 2-simplices. Experiments show that ToMA yields stable gains, with clear improvements on remote sensing and modest but consistent benefits on fashion retrieval. Additional analysis shows that ToMA is more stable than alternative topology-based objectives and that lightweight H_1-birth edges provide useful higher-order structural signals.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ToMA框架，利用持续同调识别拓扑显著边，并通过跨模态对应进行对齐，以改善视觉-语言模型在专业领域的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有半监督视觉-语言学习方法仅进行成对对齐，未能建模多模态表示流形的全局结构；而现有基于拓扑的对其方法依赖持续图匹配，既无法保证几何对齐，也未利用图像-文本配对信息。
AI.method: 提出ToMA（Topology-Aware Multimodal Representation Alignment），利用持续同调识别拓扑显著边，分别提取H_0死亡边和轻量级H_1出生边，通过跨模态对应进行对齐，无需构建2-单纯形。
AI.result: 在遥感任务上表现显著提升，在时尚检索任务上有一致但适度的改进；ToMA比替代的基于拓扑的损失函数更稳定，轻量级H_1出生边提供了有用的高阶结构信号。
AI.conclusion: ToMA通过拓扑感知的对齐方式有效提升了视觉-语言模型在专业领域的泛化能力，且H_1结构信息对性能有积极贡献。

title: TLPO: Token-Level Policy Optimization for Mitigating Language Confusion in Large Language Models
comment: Accepted to the main conference of ACL 2026
summary: Large language models (LLMs) demonstrate strong multilingual capabilities, yet often fail to consistently generate responses in the intended language, exhibiting a phenomenon known as language confusion. Prior mitigation approaches based on sequence-level fine-tuning, such as DPO, ORPO, and GRPO, operate at the level of entire responses and can lead to unintended degradation of general model capabilities, motivating the need for more fine-grained alternatives. To address this, we introduce Token-Level Policy Optimization (TLPO), a fine-tuning framework designed to mitigate language confusion through localized, token-level updates. TLPO identifies error-prone positions, explores alternative candidate tokens, and updates the policy using a tailored objective to suppress error-inducing outputs at a granular level. This selective intervention enables effective mitigation of language confusion without compromising the model's general abilities. Experiments on multiple multilingual LLMs across diverse languages demonstrate that TLPO significantly outperforms baselines in improving language consistency while preserving downstream task accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出词元级策略优化（TLPO）框架，通过局部词元级更新来缓解大语言模型的多语言混淆问题，在不损害通用能力的前提下显著提升语言一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有基于序列级微调的方法（如DPO、ORPO、GRPO）虽能缓解语言混淆，但会导致模型通用能力下降，亟需更细粒度的替代方案。
AI.method: TLPO框架通过识别易出错位置、探索替代候选词元、并采用定制目标函数在词元级抑制错误输出，实现选择性干预。
AI.result: 在多种多语言大模型和不同语言上的实验表明，TLPO在提升语言一致性和保持下游任务准确率方面显著优于基线方法。
AI.conclusion: TLPO通过词元级细粒度优化，有效缓解语言混淆问题，同时避免对模型通用能力的负面影响。

title: Translating Under Pressure: Domain-Aware LLMs for Crisis Communication
summary: Timely and reliable multilingual communication is critical during natural and human-induced disasters, but developing effective solutions for crisis communication is limited by the scarcity of curated parallel data. We propose a domain-adaptive pipeline that expands a small reference corpus, by retrieving and filtering data from general corpora. We use the resulting dataset to fine-tune a small language model for crisis-domain translation and then apply preference optimization to bias outputs toward CEFR A2-level English. Automatic and human evaluation shows that this approach improves readability, while maintaining strong adequacy. Our results indicate that simplified English, combined with domain adaptation, can function as a practical lingua franca for emergency communication when full multilingual coverage is not feasible.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种领域自适应管道，通过扩充小规模参考语料库，微调小语言模型并进行偏好优化，生成CEFR A2级别的简化英文翻译，用于灾难场景下的多语言危机通信。
AI.motivation: 自然灾害和人为灾难期间，及时可靠的多语言通信至关重要，但危机沟通中缺乏高质量的平行语料数据，限制了有效解决方案的开发。
AI.method: 提出一个领域自适应管道：从通用语料库中检索并过滤数据以扩增小规模参考语料，利用扩增后的数据集微调小语言模型用于危机领域翻译，再通过偏好优化使输出偏向CEFR A2级别的简化英文。
AI.result: 自动评估和人工评估表明，该方法在保持翻译充分性的同时，显著提升了可读性。
AI.conclusion: 简化英文结合领域自适应，在无法实现全面多语言覆盖时，可作为紧急通信中实用的通用语。

title: Sparsity as a Key: Unlocking New Insights from Latent Structures for Out-of-Distribution Detection
comment: 8 pages, 6 figures, supplementary material included, CVPR 2026
summary: Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) have demonstrated significant success in interpreting Large Language Models (LLMs) by decomposing dense representations into sparse, semantic components. However, their potential for analyzing Vision Transformers (ViTs) remains largely under-explored. In this work, we present the first application of SAEs to the ViT [CLS] token for out-of-distribution (OOD) detection, addressing the limitation of existing methods that rely on entangled feature representations. We propose a novel framework utilizing a Top-k SAE to disentangle the dense [CLS] features into a structured latent space. Through this analysis, we reveal that in-distribution (ID) data exhibits consistent, class-specific activation patterns, which we formalize as Class Activation Profiles (CAPs). Our study uncovers a key structural invariant: while ID samples preserve a stable pattern within CAPs, OOD samples systematically disrupt this structure. Leveraging this insight, we introduce a scoring function based on the divergence of core energy profiles to quantify the deviation from ideal activation profiles. Our method achieves strong results on the FPR95 metric, critical for safety-sensitive applications across multiple benchmarks, while also achieving competitive AUROC. Overall, our findings demonstrate that the sparse, disentangled features revealed by SAEs can serve as a powerful, interpretable tool for robust OOD detection in vision models.

AI.tldr: 本文首次将稀疏自编码器（SAE）应用于Vision Transformer（ViT）的[CLS] token进行分布外（OOD）检测，提出基于Top-k SAE的解耦框架，发现分布内（ID）数据具有类别特异性激活模式（CAP），并利用这一结构不变性设计能量分布偏离评分函数，在FPR95指标上表现优异。
AI.motivation: 现有OOD检测方法依赖于纠缠的特征表示，性能受限；SAE在LLM解释中已取得成功，但尚未被用于分析ViT的[CLS] token进行OOD检测。
AI.method: 使用Top-k SAE对ViT的[CLS] token进行解耦，提取稀疏潜在空间；定义类别激活模式（CAP）；基于核心能量分布偏离度设计OOD评分函数。
AI.result: 在多个基准上，FPR95指标表现优异，AUROC指标也达到竞争性水平。
AI.conclusion: SAE揭示的稀疏、解耦特征可作为视觉模型中进行鲁棒OOD检测的强大可解释工具。

title: Zero-Shot to Full-Resource: Cross-lingual Transfer Strategies for Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis
summary: Aspect-based Sentiment Analysis (ABSA) extracts fine-grained opinions toward specific aspects within text but remains largely English-focused despite major advances in transformer-based and instruction-tuned models. This work presents a multilingual evaluation of state-of-the-art ABSA approaches across seven languages (English, German, French, Dutch, Russian, Spanish, and Czech) and four subtasks (ACD, ACSA, TASD, ASQP). We systematically compare different transformer architectures under zero-resource, data-only, and full-resource settings, using cross-lingual transfer, code-switching and machine translation. Fine-tuned Large Language Models (LLMs) achieve the highest overall scores, particularly in complex generative tasks, while few-shot counterparts approach this performance in simpler setups, where smaller encoder models also remain competitive. Cross-lingual training on multiple non-target languages yields the strongest transfer for fine-tuned LLMs, while smaller encoder or seq-to-seq models benefit most from code-switching, highlighting architecture-specific strategies for multilingual ABSA. We further contribute two new German datasets, an adapted GERestaurant and the first German ASQP dataset (GERest), to encourage multilingual ABSA research beyond English.

AI.tldr: 本文对方面级情感分析（ABSA）在七种语言和四个子任务上进行了多语言评估，比较了不同Transformer架构在零资源、数据仅和全资源设置下的表现。微调的大语言模型（LLM）在复杂生成任务中表现最佳，而少样本方法在简单设置中接近该性能。研究还贡献了两个新的德语数据集。
AI.motivation: ABSA研究主要集中在英语上，缺乏对多语言场景下各种先进方法的系统性比较，因此需要评估不同架构在不同语言和资源设置下的表现，以推动多语言ABSA研究。
AI.method: 在七种语言（英、德、法、荷、俄、西、捷）上对四个ABSA子任务（ACD、ACSA、TASD、ASQP）进行评估，比较不同Transformer架构（包括微调LLM、少样本LLM、小型编码器模型等），采用跨语言迁移、代码切换和机器翻译等策略，在零资源、数据仅和全资源三种设置下进行实验。
AI.result: 微调LLM在复杂生成任务中取得最高分数；少样本LLM在简单设置中接近该性能；跨语言训练对微调LLM最有效；代码切换对小模型最有益；模型架构影响多语言ABSA策略选择。
AI.conclusion: 不同架构需要不同的多语言ABSA策略，微调LLM适合复杂任务，小型模型在简单任务中仍有竞争力。贡献的两个德语数据集可推动非英语ABSA研究。

title: OCR-Memory: Optical Context Retrieval for Long-Horizon Agent Memory
summary: Autonomous LLM agents increasingly operate in long-horizon, interactive settings where success depends on reusing experience accumulated over extended histories. However, existing agent memory systems are fundamentally constrained by text-context budgets: storing or revisiting raw trajectories is prohibitively token-expensive, while summarization and text-only retrieval trade token savings for information loss and fragmented evidence. To address this limitation, we propose Optical Context Retrieval Memory (OCR-Memory), a memory framework that leverages the visual modality as a high-density representation of agent experience, enabling retention of arbitrarily long histories with minimal prompt overhead at retrieval time. Specifically, OCR-Memory renders historical trajectories into images annotated with unique visual identifiers. OCR-Memory retrieves stored experience via a \emph{locate-and-transcribe} paradigm that selects relevant regions through visual anchors and retrieves the corresponding verbatim text, avoiding free-form generation and reducing hallucination. Experiments on long-horizon agent benchmarks show consistent gains under strict context limits, demonstrating that optical encoding increases effective memory capacity while preserving faithful evidence recovery.

AI.tldr: 提出OCR-Memory框架，通过将智能体历史轨迹渲染为图像（视觉模态）来存储经验，采用定位-转录范式检索，在长程任务中突破文本上下文预算限制，实现高密度记忆保留与忠实证据恢复。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体记忆系统受限于文本上下文预算：直接存储原始轨迹的token成本过高，而摘要和纯文本检索会导致信息丢失和证据碎片化。
AI.method: 1) 将历史轨迹渲染为带有唯一视觉标识符的图片进行存储；2) 采用定位-转录（locate-and-transcribe）范式，通过视觉锚点选择相关区域并检索对应原文文本，避免自由生成以减少幻觉。
AI.result: 在长程智能体基准测试中，严格上下文限制下取得一致性的性能提升，光学编码在保持忠实证据恢复的同时增加了有效记忆容量。
AI.conclusion: 利用视觉模态的高密度表征特性可以有效突破文本上下文的记忆瓶颈，为长程交互场景下的智能体记忆设计提供了新思路。

title: Differentially-Private Text Rewriting reshapes Linguistic Style
summary: Differential Privacy (DP) for text matured from disjointed word-level substitutions to contiguous sentence-level rewriting by leveraging the generative capacity of language models. While this form of text privatization is best suited for balancing formal privacy guarantees with grammatical coherence, its impact on the register identity of text remains largely unexplored.
